/* One-time public catalogue price change. All public and customer sale prices change; expired prices and history remain intact. */
const OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION='oky-public-price-plus15-except-seafood-2026-10-12-v1';
const OKY_PRICE15_TASKS=new WeakMap();
function okyPrice15IsSeafood(p){const normalize=v=>String(v||'').replace(/İ/g,'i').replace(/I/g,'ı').toLowerCase().normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/ı/g,'i').replace(/[-_]+/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(),name=normalize(p.name);const label=/^(?:(?:dondurulmus|donuk|taze) )?(?:balik(?:lar)?(?: urunleri)?|deniz urunleri|su urunleri|karides(?:ler)?|kalamar(?:lar)?|ahtapot(?:lar)?|black tiger|unagi)$/;return okyEdtIsSeafood(p)||[p.category,p.subcategory].some(v=>label.test(normalize(v)))||['edt_473','edt_474','edt_476'].includes(String(p.id))||/\bton\s+baligi\b/.test(name)}
function okyPrice15Round(value){const n=Number(value);return Number.isFinite(n)&&n>=0?Math.round(Math.round(n*100)*115/100)/100:null}
function okyPrice15Fallback(products){const known=new Set(OKY_EDT_SEAFOOD_SNAPSHOT.products.flatMap(p=>[String(p.id),String(p.source_product_id||''),String(p.sku||'')]).filter(Boolean));return products.map(p=>{if(known.has(String(p.id))||known.has(String(p.source_product_id||''))||known.has(String(p.sku||''))||okyPrice15IsSeafood(p)||p.price15Applied===OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION)return {...p};const out={...p,price15Applied:OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION};for(const f of ['effectivePrice','basePrice','price','sale_price','list_price','listPrice'])if(p[f]!=null&&p[f]!==''&&Number.isFinite(Number(p[f]))&&Number(p[f])>=0)out[f]=okyPrice15Round(p[f]);return out})}
async function okyEnsurePrice15(env,DB){
 if(!DB)throw Error('PRICE15_DATABASE_REQUIRED');if(OKY_PRICE15_TASKS.has(DB))return await OKY_PRICE15_TASKS.get(DB);
 const task=(async()=>{
 try{if(await DB.prepare('SELECT id FROM oky_price15_migrations_v1 WHERE id=?').bind(OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION).first())return true}catch(error){if(!/no such table/i.test(String(error?.message||error)))throw error}
 if(!await DB.prepare('SELECT id FROM oky_catalog_import_batches_v1 WHERE id=?').bind(OKY_EDT_MIGRATION).first())throw Error('PRICE15_CATALOG_NOT_READY');
 const ddl=[
 "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oky_price15_migrations_v1(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,completed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(datetime('now')),percent REAL NOT NULL,product_count INTEGER NOT NULL)",
 "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oky_price15_products_v1(migration_id TEXT NOT NULL,product_id TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(migration_id,product_id))",
 "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oky_price15_audit_v1(migration_id TEXT NOT NULL,product_id TEXT NOT NULL,old_base REAL,new_base REAL,old_list REAL,new_list REAL,old_sale REAL,new_sale REAL,old_effective REAL,new_effective REAL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(datetime('now')),PRIMARY KEY(migration_id,product_id))",
 "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oky_price15_rows_v1(migration_id TEXT NOT NULL,price_table TEXT NOT NULL,price_id TEXT NOT NULL,product_id TEXT NOT NULL,old_price REAL NOT NULL,new_price REAL NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(migration_id,price_table,price_id))",
 "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS b2b_customer_prices_v1(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,business_id TEXT NOT NULL,product_id TEXT NOT NULL,price REAL NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TRY',valid_from TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(datetime('now')),valid_until TEXT,active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(datetime('now')),updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(datetime('now')),UNIQUE(business_id,product_id))",
 "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oky_price15_checks_v1(migration_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,passed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(passed=1))"
 ];for(const sql of ddl){const r=await DB.prepare(sql).run();if(r?.success===false)throw Error('PRICE15_SCHEMA_FAILED')}
 const cats=(await DB.prepare('SELECT id,parent_id,name,slug FROM oky_storefront_categories_v1').all()).results||[];
 const norm=v=>String(v||'').replace(/İ/g,'i').replace(/I/g,'ı').toLowerCase().normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/ı/g,'i').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g,'');
 const seaCats=new Set(cats.filter(c=>okyPrice15IsSeafood({category:c.name})||okyPrice15IsSeafood({category:c.slug})||c.id===OKY_EDT_SEAFOOD_SNAPSHOT.category.id).map(c=>c.id));let changed=true;while(changed){changed=false;for(const c of cats)if(seaCats.has(c.parent_id)&&!seaCats.has(c.id)){seaCats.add(c.id);changed=true}}
 const seaNames=new Set(cats.filter(c=>seaCats.has(c.id)).flatMap(c=>[norm(c.id),norm(c.name),norm(c.slug)]));
 const known=new Set(OKY_EDT_SEAFOOD_SNAPSHOT.products.flatMap(p=>[String(p.id),String(p.source_product_id||''),String(p.sku||'')]).filter(Boolean));
 const products=(await DB.prepare('SELECT p.id,p.source_product_id,p.name,p.category,c.sku,c.subcategory FROM b2b_products_v1 p LEFT JOIN oky_product_commerce_v1 c ON c.product_id=p.id').all()).results||[];
 const eligible=products.filter(p=>!known.has(String(p.id))&&!known.has(String(p.source_product_id||''))&&!known.has(String(p.sku||''))&&!okyPrice15IsSeafood(p)&&!seaNames.has(norm(p.category))&&!seaNames.has(norm(p.subcategory))).map(p=>String(p.id));
 const guard="NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_price15_migrations_v1 WHERE id='"+OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION+"')",pool="SELECT product_id FROM oky_price15_products_v1 WHERE migration_id='"+OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION+"'",valid="active=1 AND (valid_until IS NULL OR datetime(valid_until)>datetime('now'))",currentId="SELECT pr.id FROM b2b_prices_v1 pr WHERE pr.product_id=p.id AND pr.active=1 AND (pr.valid_until IS NULL OR datetime(pr.valid_until)>datetime('now')) AND (pr.valid_from IS NULL OR datetime(pr.valid_from)<=datetime('now')) ORDER BY pr.valid_from DESC,pr.rowid DESC LIMIT 1";
 const commands=[];const add=(sql,...args)=>commands.push(DB.prepare(sql).bind(...args));
 add('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO oky_price15_products_v1(migration_id,product_id) SELECT ?,value FROM json_each(?) WHERE '+guard,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION,JSON.stringify(eligible));
 // Read prices inside the transaction, so concurrent admin edits preceding it become the baseline.
 const number=expr=>"CASE WHEN "+expr+" IS NOT NULL AND typeof("+expr+") IN ('integer','real') AND "+expr+">=0 THEN "+expr+" ELSE NULL END";
 const base=number('pr.price'),list=number('pc.list_price'),sale=number('pc.sale_price'),effective='COALESCE('+sale+','+base+','+list+')';
 add('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO oky_price15_audit_v1(migration_id,product_id,old_base,new_base,old_list,new_list,old_sale,new_sale,old_effective,new_effective) SELECT ?,p.id,'+base+',ROUND(ROUND(('+base+')*100)*115/100)/100,'+list+',ROUND(ROUND(('+list+')*100)*115/100)/100,'+sale+',ROUND(ROUND(('+sale+')*100)*115/100)/100,'+effective+',ROUND(ROUND(('+effective+')*100)*115/100)/100 FROM b2b_products_v1 p LEFT JOIN oky_product_commerce_v1 pc ON pc.product_id=p.id LEFT JOIN b2b_prices_v1 pr ON pr.id=('+currentId+') WHERE p.id IN('+pool+') AND '+guard,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION);
 const rowEligible="product_id IN("+pool+") AND "+valid+" AND typeof(price) IN ('integer','real') AND price>=0 AND (datetime(valid_from)>datetime('now') OR id=(SELECT pcur.id FROM b2b_prices_v1 pcur WHERE pcur.product_id=b2b_prices_v1.product_id AND pcur.active=1 AND (pcur.valid_until IS NULL OR datetime(pcur.valid_until)>datetime('now')) AND (pcur.valid_from IS NULL OR datetime(pcur.valid_from)<=datetime('now')) ORDER BY pcur.valid_from DESC,pcur.rowid DESC LIMIT 1))";
 add("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO oky_price15_rows_v1(migration_id,price_table,price_id,product_id,old_price,new_price) SELECT ?,'b2b_prices_v1',id,product_id,price,ROUND(ROUND(price*100)*115/100)/100 FROM b2b_prices_v1 WHERE "+rowEligible+' AND '+guard,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION);
 add("UPDATE b2b_prices_v1 SET price=(SELECT r.new_price FROM oky_price15_rows_v1 r WHERE r.migration_id=? AND r.price_table='b2b_prices_v1' AND r.price_id=b2b_prices_v1.id) WHERE id IN(SELECT price_id FROM oky_price15_rows_v1 WHERE migration_id=? AND price_table='b2b_prices_v1') AND "+guard,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION);
 const customerEligible="product_id IN("+pool+") AND "+valid+" AND typeof(price) IN ('integer','real') AND price>=0 AND (datetime(valid_from)>datetime('now') OR id=(SELECT cp.id FROM b2b_customer_prices_v1 cp WHERE cp.product_id=b2b_customer_prices_v1.product_id AND cp.business_id=b2b_customer_prices_v1.business_id AND cp.active=1 AND (cp.valid_until IS NULL OR datetime(cp.valid_until)>datetime('now')) AND (cp.valid_from IS NULL OR datetime(cp.valid_from)<=datetime('now')) ORDER BY cp.valid_from DESC,cp.rowid DESC LIMIT 1))";
 add("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO oky_price15_rows_v1(migration_id,price_table,price_id,product_id,old_price,new_price) SELECT ?,'b2b_customer_prices_v1',id,product_id,price,ROUND(ROUND(price*100)*115/100)/100 FROM b2b_customer_prices_v1 WHERE "+customerEligible+' AND '+guard,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION);
 add("UPDATE b2b_customer_prices_v1 SET price=(SELECT r.new_price FROM oky_price15_rows_v1 r WHERE r.migration_id=? AND r.price_table='b2b_customer_prices_v1' AND r.price_id=b2b_customer_prices_v1.id) WHERE id IN(SELECT price_id FROM oky_price15_rows_v1 WHERE migration_id=? AND price_table='b2b_customer_prices_v1') AND "+guard,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION);
 add("UPDATE oky_product_commerce_v1 SET list_price=CASE WHEN typeof(list_price) IN ('integer','real') AND list_price>=0 THEN ROUND(ROUND(list_price*100)*115/100)/100 ELSE list_price END,sale_price=CASE WHEN typeof(sale_price) IN ('integer','real') AND sale_price>=0 THEN ROUND(ROUND(sale_price*100)*115/100)/100 ELSE sale_price END WHERE product_id IN("+pool+') AND '+guard);
 // Plain INSERT ensures CHECK(passed=1) throws and rolls back on any incorrect price.
 add("INSERT INTO oky_price15_checks_v1(migration_id,passed) SELECT ?,CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oky_price15_products_v1 WHERE migration_id=?)=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oky_price15_audit_v1 WHERE migration_id=?) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_price15_rows_v1 r LEFT JOIN b2b_prices_v1 pr ON pr.id=r.price_id WHERE r.migration_id=? AND r.price_table='b2b_prices_v1' AND (pr.id IS NULL OR pr.price IS NULL OR ABS(pr.price-r.new_price)>0.001)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_price15_rows_v1 r LEFT JOIN b2b_customer_prices_v1 cp ON cp.id=r.price_id WHERE r.migration_id=? AND r.price_table='b2b_customer_prices_v1' AND (cp.id IS NULL OR cp.price IS NULL OR ABS(cp.price-r.new_price)>0.001)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_price15_audit_v1 a LEFT JOIN oky_product_commerce_v1 pc ON pc.product_id=a.product_id WHERE a.migration_id=? AND ((a.new_list IS NOT NULL AND (pc.list_price IS NULL OR ABS(pc.list_price-a.new_list)>0.001)) OR (a.new_sale IS NOT NULL AND (pc.sale_price IS NULL OR ABS(pc.sale_price-a.new_sale)>0.001)))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE "+guard,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION);
 add('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO oky_price15_migrations_v1(id,percent,product_count) SELECT ?,15,COUNT(*) FROM oky_price15_products_v1 WHERE migration_id=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_price15_checks_v1 WHERE migration_id=? AND passed=1)',OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION,OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION);
 const result=await DB.batch(commands);if(result.some(r=>r?.success===false))throw Error('PRICE15_ATOMIC_BATCH_FAILED');if(!await DB.prepare('SELECT id FROM oky_price15_migrations_v1 WHERE id=?').bind(OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION).first())throw Error('PRICE15_COMMIT_NOT_VERIFIED');return true;
 })();OKY_PRICE15_TASKS.set(DB,task);try{return await task}catch(error){OKY_PRICE15_TASKS.delete(DB);throw error}
}

    function seo200TargetValid(d){
      try{const u=new URL(seo200CatalogTarget(d),GOOGLE_GROWTH_ARCHITECTURE.canonicalOrigin);return u.origin===GOOGLE_GROWTH_ARCHITECTURE.canonicalOrigin&&u.pathname==="/urunler"&&u.searchParams.get("source")==="seo200"&&(!u.searchParams.has("category")||["deniz-urunleri","donuk-urunler","et-sarkuteri","sut-sarkuteri","yaglar","soslar","kuru-gida","baharat"].includes(u.searchParams.get("category")))}catch{return false}
    }
    function seo200Audit(){
      const paths=SEO_200_ROUTES, labels=paths.map(p=>SEO_200_ROUTE_DATA[p].label), targets=paths.map(p=>SEO_200_ROUTE_DATA[p].target);
      const productIds=new Set(["all",...PRODUCTS.map(x=>x.id)]);
      return Object.freeze({ok:paths.length===200&&new Set(paths).size===200&&new Set(labels).size===200&&paths.every(p=>p.startsWith("/")&&SEO_200_ROUTE_DATA[p].indexable&&SEO_200_ROUTE_DATA[p].sitemap&&SEO_200_ROUTE_DATA[p].homeIndex&&productIds.has(SEO_200_ROUTE_DATA[p].categoryId)&&seo200TargetValid(SEO_200_ROUTE_DATA[p])),routes:paths.length,uniqueRoutes:new Set(paths).size,uniqueLabels:new Set(labels).size,edtRoutes:paths.filter(p=>p.startsWith("/edt-")).length,homeLinks:paths.filter(p=>SEO_200_ROUTE_DATA[p].homeIndex).length,sitemapLinks:paths.filter(p=>SEO_200_ROUTE_DATA[p].sitemap).length});
    }

    function googleGrowthSitemapXml(){
      const esc=v=>String(v).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;").replace(/\"/g,"&quot;").replace(/'/g,"&apos;");
      return '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">'+SEO_ALL_INDEXABLE_ROUTES.map(p=>'<url><loc>'+esc(GOOGLE_GROWTH_ARCHITECTURE.canonicalOrigin+p)+'</loc></url>').join('')+'</urlset>';

    function catalogSkuKey(p){return[p.brand,p.name,p.variant,p.amount,p.package,p.brand===""?p.subCategory:""].map(v=>String(v||"").normalize("NFKC").trim().replace(/\s+/g," ").toLocaleUpperCase("tr-TR")).join("|")}

    const UNBRANDED_FULL_CATALOG=Object.freeze([]); // Historical supplier catalog withdrawn, not renamed.
    const LEZITA_CATALOG=Object.freeze([]);
    const BOOL_CATALOG=Object.freeze([]);
    const GASTRO34_CATALOG=Object.freeze([]);
    const ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CATALOG = Object.freeze((()=>{const seen=new Set(),out=[];for(const p of [...UNBRANDED_FULL_CATALOG,...LEZITA_CATALOG,...BOOL_CATALOG,...GASTRO34_CATALOG,...PRODUCT_CATALOG]){if(retiredSupplierProduct(p))continue;const key=catalogSkuKey(p);if(seen.has(key))continue;seen.add(key);out.push(p)}return out})());
    okyImportedPublicFallback(ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CATALOG);

    function canonicalizeHTML(content, pathname="/") {
      if (!/<link\s+rel=["\']canonical["\']/i.test(content)) { const clean=pathname==="/"?"/":pathname.replace(/\/+$/,""); const canonical="https://"+CONFIG.primaryDomain+clean; content=content.replace("</head>",`<link rel="canonical" href="${canonical}"></head>`); }
      return content;
    }

    function responseJSON(data, status = 200, extraHeaders = {}) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2), {
        status,
        headers: {
          "content-type": "application/json; charset=UTF-8",
          "cache-control": "no-store",
          "x-content-type-options": "nosniff",
          ...extraHeaders
        }
      });
    }

    function escapeHTML(value) {
      return String(value ?? "")
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
    }

    function renderProducts() {
      return PRODUCTS.map((p) => `
        <article
          class="product"
          data-search="${escapeHTML(
            p.name.replace(/İ/g,'i').replace(/I/g,'ı').toLowerCase()
          )}"
        >
          <div class="productVisual">
            <span>${p.icon}</span>
          </div>

          <div class="productBody">
            <small>OKYANUS EDT</small>
            <h3>${escapeHTML(p.name)}</h3>
            <p>${escapeHTML(p.text)}</p>

            <button
              type="button"
              class="addProduct"
              data-id="${escapeHTML(p.id)}"
              data-name="${escapeHTML(p.name)}"
            >
              + Teklif Listesine Ekle
            </button>
          </div>
        </article>
      `).join("");
    }


    function renderCatalogProducts() {
      return ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CATALOG.map((p) => {
        const anonymousSource = !p.brand;
        const cleanCategoryPart = (value) => String(value || "").replace(/\s*[\u00b7|\-]\s*[\u00b7|\-]+/g, " \u00b7 ").replace(/^\s*[\u00b7|\-]+|[\u00b7|\-]+\s*$/g, "").replace(/\s{2,}/g, " ").trim();
        const visibleSubCategory = cleanCategoryPart(p.subCategory);
        const meta = [p.variant, p.amount, p.package].filter(Boolean).join(" \u00b7 ");
        const unitSource = [p.package,p.amount].filter(Boolean).join(" ").replace(/İ/g,'i').replace(/I/g,'ı').toLowerCase();
        const defaultUnit = /\bkoli\b/.test(unitSource)?"Koli":/\bpaket\b|\bpkt\b/.test(unitSource)?"Paket":/\bteneke\b|\btnk\b/.test(unitSource)?"Teneke":/\bkova\b/.test(unitSource)?"Kova":/\bkutu\b/.test(unitSource)?"Kutu":/\b\u015fi\u015fe\b/.test(unitSource)?"\u015ei\u015fe":/\bkasa\b/.test(unitSource)?"Kasa":/\bkg\b/.test(unitSource)?"Kg":/\b(?:gr|gram)\b/.test(unitSource)?"Gram":/\b(?:lt|litre)\b/.test(unitSource)?"Litre":"Adet";
        const search = [
          p.brand,p.name,p.variant,p.category,p.masterCategory,p.subCategory,p.amount,p.package,p.detail,p.search
        ].filter(Boolean).join(" ").replace(/\s{2,}/g, " ").trim().replace(/İ/g,'i').replace(/I/g,'ı').toLowerCase();
        return `
          <label class="product" data-category="${escapeHTML(p.category)}" data-search="${escapeHTML(search)}">
            <div class="productBody">
              <div class="productTop"><div class="productCategory">${escapeHTML([p.category,visibleSubCategory].filter(Boolean).join(" \u00b7 "))}</div><input class="productCheck" type="checkbox" data-id="${escapeHTML(p.id)}" data-name="${escapeHTML([anonymousSource?"":p.brand,p.name,p.variant,p.amount,p.package].filter(Boolean).join(" \u00b7 "))}" data-unit="${escapeHTML(defaultUnit)}" aria-label="${escapeHTML(p.name)} \u00fcr\u00fcn\u00fcn\u00fc teklif listesine ekle"></div>
              ${anonymousSource?"":`<small>${escapeHTML(p.brand || "Okyanus EDT")}</small>`}
              <h3>${escapeHTML(p.name)}</h3>
              ${anonymousSource?(meta?`<p class="meta">${escapeHTML(meta)}</p>`:""):`<p class="meta">${escapeHTML(meta || p.detail || "Profesyonel mutfak \u00fcr\u00fcn\u00fc")}</p>`}
              <div class="cardOrder" data-order-for="${escapeHTML(p.id)}" hidden><div><span>Miktar</span><input class="cardQty" type="number" min="0.01" max="100000" step="0.01" value="1" inputmode="decimal" aria-label="${escapeHTML(p.name)} miktar\u0131"></div><div><span>Birim</span><select class="cardUnit" aria-label="${escapeHTML(p.name)} birimi">${["Adet","Paket","Koli","Kg","Gram","Litre","Teneke","Kova","Kutu","\u015ei\u015fe","Kasa"].map(u=>`<option${u===defaultUnit?" selected":""}>${u}</option>`).join("")}</select></div></div>
            </div>
          </label>`;
      }).join("");
    }

    function replaceHomeDigitalMenuShowcase(base,replacement){
      const marker='<section class="digitalMenuHero"';
      const start=base.indexOf(marker);
      if(start<0){
        console.error('VITRINE_TARGET_NOT_FOUND');
        return base;
      }
      const end=base.indexOf('</section>',start);
      if(end<0){
        console.error('VITRINE_TARGET_END_NOT_FOUND');
        return base;
      }
      return base.slice(0,start)+replacement+base.slice(end+'</section>'.length);
    }

    function vitrineSectionHTML(row,p){
      const scenes=Array.isArray(p&&p.scenes)?p.scenes.slice(0,8):[];
      const cards=scenes.map(s=>{
        const url=safeVitrineUrl(s.url);
        const media=url
          ?(s.type==='video'
            ?`<video controls playsinline preload="metadata" src="${escapeHTML(url)}"></video>`
            :`<img loading="eager" src="${escapeHTML(url)}" alt="${escapeHTML(s.headline||row?.title||'Okyanus EDT')}">`)
          :'';
        return `<article class="okyVCard">${media}<div><h3>${escapeHTML(s.headline||row?.title||'Okyanus EDT')}</h3><p>${escapeHTML(s.text||'')}</p>${s.cta?`<span class="okyVCTA">${escapeHTML(s.cta)}</span>`:''}</div></article>`;
      }).join('');
      const body=cards
        ?`<div class="okyVGrid">${cards}</div>`
        :`<div class="okyVEmpty"><b>Okyanus Vitrini</b><span>Yeni i\u00e7erik haz\u0131rlan\u0131yor.</span></div>`;
      return `<section id="okyanus-vitrini" class="okyVitrine" data-published-at="${escapeHTML(row?.published_at||'')}"><div class="okyVHead"><small>OKYANUS EDT</small><h2>Okyanus Vitrini</h2></div>${body}</section><style id="oky-vitrine-style-v13">.okyVitrine{max-width:1180px;margin:28px auto;padding:22px}.okyVHead h2{margin:4px 0 16px;color:#07345d}.okyVGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:16px}.okyVCard{overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #06233d18}.okyVCard img,.okyVCard video{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;background:#061831}.okyVCard div{padding:16px}.okyVCard h3{margin:0 0 7px;color:#07345d}.okyVCard p{margin:0;line-height:1.5}.okyVCTA{display:inline-block;margin-top:10px;font-weight:700;color:#0b65b1}.okyVEmpty{min-height:220px;display:grid;place-content:center;gap:8px;text-align:center;border-radius:18px;background:#f4f8fb;color:#07345d}.okyVEmpty b{font-size:24px}.okyVEmpty span{color:#61788a}@media(max-width:700px){.okyVitrine{padding:14px}.okyVGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}</style>`;
    }

    async function homePageWithVitrine(env){
      const base=homePage();
      const placeholder=vitrineSectionHTML(null,{scenes:[]});
      try{
        if(!env.ADMIN_DB){
          console.error('VITRINE_ADMIN_DB_MISSING');
          return replaceHomeDigitalMenuShowcase(base,placeholder);
        }
        const active=(await env.ADMIN_DB.prepare(`SELECT id,project_id,title,payload_json,published_at FROM studio_publications WHERE slot='homepage_vitrine' AND active=1 ORDER BY published_at DESC LIMIT 2`).all()).results||[];
        if(active.length>1){
          console.error('VITRINE_MULTIPLE_ACTIVE_PUBLICATIONS',active.length);
          return replaceHomeDigitalMenuShowcase(base,placeholder);
        }
        const row=active[0]||null;
        if(!row)return replaceHomeDigitalMenuShowcase(base,placeholder);
        let p={};
        try{p=JSON.parse(row.payload_json||'{}')}
        catch(e){
          console.error('VITRINE_PAYLOAD_INVALID',e?.message||e);
          return replaceHomeDigitalMenuShowcase(base,placeholder);
        }
        return replaceHomeDigitalMenuShowcase(base,vitrineSectionHTML(row,p));
      }catch(e){
        console.error('VITRINE_FALLBACK',e?.message||e);
        return replaceHomeDigitalMenuShowcase(base,placeholder);
      }
    }

    function safeVitrineUrl(v){try{const u=new URL(String(v||''));return u.protocol==='https:'?u.href:''}catch{return ''}}

    /* OKYANUS VITRIN LIVE HYDRATION v1.1
       D1/API do\u011fru olsa bile eski HTML/SW g\u00f6r\u00fcnt\u00fcs\u00fcn\u00fc ezerek aktif yay\u0131n\u0131 ekrana getirir. */
    function vitrineLiveHydrationScript(){
      return `<script id="oky-vitrine-live-v13">
    (()=>{const esc=v=>String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));

    function ensureTarget(){
     let section=document.getElementById('okyanus-vitrini');
     if(section)return section;
     const old=document.querySelector('.digitalMenuHero');
     section=document.createElement('section');
     section.id='okyanus-vitrini';section.className='okyVitrine';
     if(old){old.replaceWith(section);return section}
     const lower=document.querySelector('section.lower');
     if(lower&&lower.parentNode){lower.parentNode.insertBefore(section,lower);return section}
     const main=document.querySelector('main');if(main){main.appendChild(section);return section}
     return null;
    }
    async function refreshVitrine(){
     try{
      const r=await fetch('/api/vitrine?ts='+Date.now(),{cache:'no-store',headers:{accept:'application/json','cache-control':'no-cache'}});
      if(!r.ok)throw Error('VITRINE_API_'+r.status);
      const j=await r.json(),d=j&&j.ok?j.data:null,p=d&&d.payload||{},scenes=Array.isArray(p.scenes)?p.scenes.slice(0,8):[];
      const section=ensureTarget();if(!section)return;

    function render(){const box=$('ingredients');box.textContent='';state.ingredients.forEach((x,i)=>{const div=document.createElement('div');div.className='oraIngredient';[['name','Malzeme','text'],['quantity','Miktar','number'],['unitCost','Birim \u20ba','number']].forEach(([key,placeholder,type])=>{const input=document.createElement('input');input.type=type;input.placeholder=placeholder;input.value=x[key]??'';input.className=key==='quantity'?'oraQty':key==='unitCost'?'oraCost':'';input.setAttribute('aria-label',(i+1)+'. malzeme '+placeholder);if(type==='number'){input.min='0';input.step='any';input.inputMode='decimal';input.max=key==='quantity'?'10000000':'1000000000'}input.oninput=()=>{x[key]=type==='number'?Number(String(input.value).replace(',','.')):input.value;markDirty();calc()};div.appendChild(input)});const select=document.createElement('select');select.className='oraUnit';select.setAttribute('aria-label',(i+1)+'. malzeme birimi');['g','kg','ml','lt','adet'].forEach(unit=>{const option=document.createElement('option');option.value=unit;option.textContent=unit;option.selected=x.unit===unit;select.appendChild(option)});select.onchange=()=>{x.unit=select.value;markDirty();calc()};div.insertBefore(select,div.children[2]);const remove=document.createElement('button');remove.type='button';remove.className='oraRemove';remove.textContent='Sil';remove.onclick=()=>{if(saving)return;state.ingredients.splice(i,1);markDirty();render()};div.appendChild(remove);box.appendChild(div)});calc()}
    function payload(recordStatus){const title=$('rTitle').value.trim(),servings=Number($('rServings').value);if(!title)throw Error('Re\u00e7ete ad\u0131n\u0131 yaz\u0131n.');if(!Number.isFinite(servings)||servings<=0||servings>100000)throw Error('Porsiyon say\u0131s\u0131 0\u2019dan b\u00fcy\u00fck ve en fazla 100.000 olmal\u0131d\u0131r.');const ingredients=[];state.ingredients.forEach((item,i)=>{const name=String(item.name||'').trim(),quantity=Number(item.quantity),unitCost=Number(item.unitCost);if(!name&&quantity===0&&unitCost===0)return;if(!name)throw Error((i+1)+'. malzemenin ad\u0131n\u0131 yaz\u0131n.');if(!Number.isFinite(quantity)||quantity<0||quantity>1e7)throw Error((i+1)+'. malzemenin miktar\u0131n\u0131 kontrol edin.');if(!Number.isFinite(unitCost)||unitCost<0||unitCost>1e9)throw Error((i+1)+'. malzemenin birim maliyetini kontrol edin.');if(!['g','kg','ml','lt','adet'].includes(item.unit))throw Error((i+1)+'. malzemenin birimini se\u00e7in.');ingredients.push({name,quantity,unit:item.unit,unitCost})});if(!ingredients.length)throw Error('En az bir malzemenin ad\u0131n\u0131 ve bilgilerini girin.');return{id:state.id,version:state.version,title,category:$('rCategory').value.trim(),servings,variation:$('rVariation').checked,variationName:$('rVariationName').value.trim(),ingredients,steps:state.steps||[],status:recordStatus}}
    async function responseData(response){let body;try{body=await response.json()}catch(_){throw Error('Sunucudan ge\u00e7erli yan\u0131t al\u0131namad\u0131. Re\u00e7ete ekranda korundu.')}if(!response.ok||!body||!body.ok){if(response.status===401)throw Error('Oturumunuz sona erdi. Re\u00e7eteyi ekranda koruyarak yeniden giri\u015f yap\u0131n.');if(response.status===409)throw Error('Re\u00e7etenin s\u00fcr\u00fcm\u00fc de\u011fi\u015fti. Kay\u0131tl\u0131 listeyi kontrol ederek yeniden a\u00e7\u0131n.');if(response.status===403)throw Error('Bu i\u015flem i\u00e7in hesab\u0131n\u0131z\u0131n kay\u0131t yetkisi bulunmuyor.');throw Error(body&&body.message||'Re\u00e7ete hizmeti i\u015flemi tamamlayamad\u0131. Bilgileriniz ekranda korundu.')}return body}
    function setSaving(value){saving=value;['saveDraft','saveRecipe','oraNew','addIngredient'].forEach(id=>$(id).disabled=value);$('saveRecipe').textContent=value?'Kaydediliyor\u2026':'Re\u00e7eteyi Kaydet'}
    async function save(recordStatus){if(saving)return;let data;try{data=payload(recordStatus)}catch(error){notify(error.message);return}const revisionAtStart=revision;setSaving(true);notify('Re\u00e7ete kaydediliyor\u2026');try{const response=await fetch('/api/member/recipes',{method:state.id?'PUT':'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json','accept':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(data)}),body=await responseData(response);if(!body.id||!Number.isInteger(Number(body.version))||Number(body.version)<1)throw Error('Sunucu kay\u0131t kimli\u011fini do\u011frulayamad\u0131. Re\u00e7ete bilgileri ekranda korundu.')}finally{setSaving(false)}}
    async function loadList(){const response=await fetch('/api/member/recipes',{headers:{accept:'application/json'}}),body=await responseData(response),box=$('recipeList');if(!Array.isArray(body.recipes))throw Error('Kay\u0131tl\u0131 liste yan\u0131t\u0131 do\u011frulanamad\u0131.');box.textContent='';body.recipes.forEach(recipe=>{const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.textContent=recipe.title+' \u00b7 '+recipe.servings+' porsiyon';button.onclick=()=>{if(saving)return;if(dirty&&!confirm('Kaydedilmemi\u015f de\u011fi\u015fiklikler silinsin mi?'))return;state={id:recipe.id,version:Number(recipe.version),ingredients:recipe.ingredients||[],steps:recipe.steps||[]};$('rTitle').value=recipe.title;$('rCategory').value=recipe.category||'';$('rServings').value=recipe.servings;$('rVariation').checked=!!recipe.variation;$('rVariationName').value=recipe.variationName||'';$('variationBox').hidden=!recipe.variation;dirty=false;revision++;notify('Kay\u0131tl\u0131 re\u00e7ete a\u00e7\u0131ld\u0131.');render();scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})};box.appendChild(button);const requested=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('recipe');if(requested===recipe.id&&!window.__memberRecipeOpened){window.__memberRecipeOpened=true;button.onclick()}});if(!body.recipes.length)box.textContent='Hen\u00fcz kay\u0131tl\u0131 re\u00e7ete yok.'}
    function fresh(){if(saving)return;state={id:'',version:0,ingredients:[],steps:[]};$('rTitle').value='';$('rCategory').value='';$('rServings').value=1;$('rVariation').checked=false;$('rVariationName').value='';$('variationBox').hidden=true;row();dirty=false;notify('')}
    $('addIngredient').onclick=()=>row();$('rVariation').onchange=()=>{$('variationBox').hidden=!$('rVariation').checked;markDirty()};$('rTitle').oninput=$('rCategory').oninput=$('rServings').oninput=$('rVariationName').oninput=()=>{markDirty();calc()};$('saveDraft').onclick=()=>save('draft');$('saveRecipe').onclick=()=>save('active');$('oraNew').onclick=()=>{if(!dirty||confirm('Kaydedilmemi\u015f de\u011fi\u015fiklikler silinsin mi?'))fresh()};$('oraBack').onclick=()=>{if(saving){notify('Kay\u0131t i\u015fleminin tamamlanmas\u0131n\u0131 bekleyin.');return}if(dirty&&!confirm('Kaydedilmemi\u015f de\u011fi\u015fiklikler var. \u00c7\u0131k\u0131ls\u0131n m\u0131?'))return;location.href='/benim-okyanusum'};fresh();loadList().catch(error=>{$('recipeList').textContent=error.message||'Re\u00e7eteler y\u00fcklenemedi.'});addEventListener('beforeunload',event=>{if(dirty||saving){event.preventDefault();event.returnValue=''}});
    })();</script></body></html>`}

    function cleanEasyRecipe(input){
     if(!input||typeof input!=="object"||Array.isArray(input))return null;
     const text=(v,n)=>String(v||"").trim().slice(0,n),num=v=>{const n=Number(v);return Number.isFinite(n)?n:NaN};
     const title=text(input.title,160),category=text(input.category,80),servings=num(input.servings);
     if(!title||!Number.isFinite(servings)||servings<=0||servings>100000)return null;
     const source=Array.isArray(input.ingredients)?input.ingredients:[];if(!source.length||source.length>100)return null;
     const ingredients=[];for(const x of source){if(!x||typeof x!=="object")return null;const name=text(x.name,120),quantity=num(x.quantity),unit=text(x.unit,12),unitCost=num(x.unitCost);if(!name&&quantity===0&&unitCost===0)continue;if(!name||!Number.isFinite(quantity)||quantity<0||quantity>1e7||!Number.isFinite(unitCost)||unitCost<0||unitCost>1e9||!["g","kg","ml","lt","adet"].includes(unit))return null;ingredients.push({name,quantity,unit,unitCost})}
     if(!ingredients.length)return null;
     const steps=(Array.isArray(input.steps)?input.steps:[]).slice(0,30).map(x=>text(x,500)).filter(Boolean);
     const variation=!!input.variation,variationName=text(input.variationName,80),status=input.status==="active"?"active":"draft";
     const out={title,category,servings,variation,variationName,ingredients,steps,status};const packed=JSON.stringify(out);if(new TextEncoder().encode(packed).byteLength>65536||/data:|base64,/i.test(packed))return null;return out;
    }

     const now=memberNow();if(request.method==="POST"){const clean=cleanEasyRecipe(body);if(!clean)return memberJSON({ok:false,error:"VALIDATION_ERROR",message:"Re\u00e7ete ad\u0131, porsiyon ve malzemeleri kontrol edin."},400);const id=memberId("rcp");await memberD1Run(env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO member_easy_recipes_v1(id,business_id,created_by_user_id,title,category,servings,payload_json,version,status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`).bind(id,me.business_id,me.user_id,clean.title,clean.category,clean.servings,JSON.stringify(clean),1,clean.status,now,now));return memberJSON({ok:true,id,version:1,updatedAt:now},201)}
     const id=String(body.id||"").slice(0,80),version=Number(body.version);if(!id||!Number.isInteger(version)||version<1)return memberJSON({ok:false,error:"VALIDATION_ERROR"},400);
     if(request.method==="DELETE"){const q=await memberD1Run(env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE member_easy_recipes_v1 SET deleted_at=?,updated_at=?,version=version+1 WHERE id=? AND business_id=? AND deleted_at IS NULL AND version=?`).bind(now,now,id,me.business_id,version));return Number(q&&q.meta&&q.meta.changes||0)?new Response(null,{status:204}):memberJSON({ok:false,error:"NOT_FOUND_OR_VERSION_CONFLICT"},404)}

    async function memberActivityAPI(request,env){
      if(!memberSameOrigin(request))return memberJSON({ok:false,error:"ORIGIN_REJECTED"},403);
      const me=await memberSession(request,env);if(!me)return memberJSON({ok:false,error:"UNAUTHENTICATED"},401);
      await memberD1Run(env.DB.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS member_customer_activity_v1 (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,business_id TEXT NOT NULL,path TEXT NOT NULL,title TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL)`));
      await memberD1Run(env.DB.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_customer_activity_user ON member_customer_activity_v1(user_id,business_id,created_at)`));
      const now=memberNow();
      if(request.method==="GET"){const q=await memberD1All(env.DB.prepare(`SELECT path,title,created_at FROM member_customer_activity_v1 WHERE user_id=? AND business_id=? AND expires_at>? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30`).bind(me.user_id,me.business_id,now));return memberJSON({ok:true,visits:q.results||[]});}
      if(request.method==="DELETE"){await memberD1Run(env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM member_customer_activity_v1 WHERE user_id=? AND business_id=?`).bind(me.user_id,me.business_id));return memberJSON({ok:true});}
      if(request.method!=="POST")return memberJSON({ok:false,error:"METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED"},405);
      let body;try{body=await request.json()}catch{return memberJSON({ok:false,error:"INVALID_BODY"},400)}
      const path=String(body.path||"").slice(0,250),title=String(body.title||"").slice(0,180);
      if(!/^\/(?:urunler|urun\/[^?#]*|kampanyalar|markalar|teslimat|hakkimizda)?$/.test(path))return memberJSON({ok:false,error:"INVALID_PATH"},400);
      const last=await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT created_at FROM member_customer_activity_v1 WHERE user_id=? AND business_id=? AND path=? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1`).bind(me.user_id,me.business_id,path).first();
      if(!last||Date.now()-Date.parse(last.created_at)>60000)await memberD1Run(env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO member_customer_activity_v1(id,user_id,business_id,path,title,created_at,expires_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`).bind(memberId("act"),me.user_id,me.business_id,path,title,now,new Date(Date.now()+40*86400000).toISOString()));
      await memberD1Run(env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM member_customer_activity_v1 WHERE expires_at<=?`).bind(now));return memberJSON({ok:true});
    }

    function memberToken(bytes=32){const a=new Uint8Array(bytes);crypto.getRandomValues(a);return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...a)).replace(/\+/g,"-").replace(/\//g,"_").replace(/=+$/g,"")}
    async function memberSHA(value){const b=await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256",new TextEncoder().encode(String(value)));return [...new Uint8Array(b)].map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("")}
    async function memberPassword(password,salt){const raw=await crypto.subtle.importKey("raw",new TextEncoder().encode(password),"PBKDF2",false,["deriveBits"]);const bits=await crypto.subtle.deriveBits({name:"PBKDF2",hash:"SHA-256",salt:new TextEncoder().encode(salt),iterations:100000},raw,256);return [...new Uint8Array(bits)].map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("")}
    function memberCookies(request){const out=/** @type {Record<string,string>} */ ({});for(const part of String(request.headers.get("cookie")||"").split(";")){const i=part.indexOf("=");if(i>0){try{out[part.slice(0,i).trim()]=decodeURIComponent(part.slice(i+1).trim())}catch(_){}}}return out}

    function cesniMethodKey(m){
      const t=String((m&&m.name)||m||"").replace(/İ/g,'i').replace(/I/g,'ı').toLowerCase();
      if(t.includes("kabayaki"))return"KABAYAKI";
      if(t.includes("shioyaki"))return"SHIOYAKI";
      if(t.includes("nitsuke"))return"NITSUKE";
      if(t.includes("tataki"))return"TATAKI";
      if(t.includes("aburi")||t.includes("alevle"))return"TORCH";
      if(t.includes("tempura"))return"TEMPURA";
      if(t.includes("nanbanzuke")||t.includes("escabeche"))return"ESCABECHE";
      if(t.includes("ceviche"))return"CEVICHE";
      if(t.includes("wok")||t.includes("stir-fry")||t.includes("stir fry"))return"WOK";
      if(t.includes("salamander")||t.includes("broil")||t.includes("\u00fcstten \u0131zgara"))return"BROIL";
      if(t.includes("pane")||t.includes("breaded"))return"BREADED_FRY";
      if(t.includes("bas\u0131n\u00e7")||t.includes("pressure"))return"PRESSURE";
      if(t.includes("clay pot")||t.includes("toprak kap"))return"CLAY_POT";
      if(t.includes("ishiyaki")||t.includes("s\u0131cak ta\u015f"))return"HOT_STONE";
      if(t.includes("blan\u015f")||t.includes("blanch"))return"BLANCH";
      if(t.includes("sous"))return"SOUS_VIDE";
      if(t.includes("d\u00fc\u015f\u00fck")||t.includes("low temp"))return"LOW_TEMP";
      if(t.includes("\u00e7in")&&t.includes("buhar"))return"CHINESE_STEAM";
      if(t.includes("papillote")||t.includes("ka\u011f\u0131t"))return"PAPILLOTE";
      if(t.includes("tuz kab")||t.includes("salt crust"))return"SALT_CRUST";
      if(t.includes("rotisserie")||t.includes("\u015fi\u015f")||t.includes("spit"))return"SPIT_ROAST";
      if(t.includes("tand\u0131r")||t.includes("tandoor"))return"TANDOOR";
      if(t.includes("plancha")||t.includes("sac"))return"PLANCHA";
      if(t.includes("t\u00fcts")||t.includes("smok"))return"SMOKE";
      if(t.includes("konfi")||t.includes("confit"))return"CONFIT";
      if(t.includes("po\u015fe")||t.includes("poach")||t.includes("nizakana"))return"POACH";
      if(t.includes("simmer")||t.includes("k\u0131s\u0131k"))return"SIMMER";
      if(t.includes("g\u00fcve\u00e7")||t.includes("yahni")||t.includes("stew")||t.includes("moqueca"))return"STEW";
      if(t.includes("braise")||t.includes("a\u011f\u0131r"))return"BRAISE";
      if(t.includes("sote")||t.includes("saut\u00e9"))return"SAUTE";
      if(t.includes("m\u00fch\u00fcr")||t.includes("sear"))return"SEAR";
      if(t.includes("s\u0131\u011f")&&t.includes("k\u0131zart"))return"SHALLOW_FRY";
      if(t.includes("k\u0131zart")||t.includes("deep-fry")||t.includes("deep fry"))return"FRY";
      if(t.includes("\u0131zgara")||t.includes("grill"))return"GRILL";
      if(t.includes("roast")||t.includes("f\u0131r\u0131nda k\u0131z"))return"ROAST";
      if(t.includes("f\u0131r\u0131n")||t.includes("oven")||t.includes("bake"))return"OVEN";
      if(t.includes("buhar")||t.includes("steam"))return"STEAM";
      if(t.includes("tava")||t.includes("pan-fry")||t.includes("pan fry"))return"PAN";
      if(t.includes("ha\u015f")||t.includes("boil"))return"BOIL";
      if(t.includes("graten")||t.includes("gratin"))return"GRATIN";
      if(t.includes("rejener")||t.includes("finishing")||t.includes("reheat"))return"REGENERATE";
      if(t.includes("k\u00fcr")||t.includes("cure")||t.includes("tuzlama"))return"CURE";
      if(t.includes("pickle")||t.includes("asitle"))return"PICKLE";
      if(t.includes("marine")||t.includes("marinasyon"))return"MARINATE";
      return null;
    }

    function cesniSafetyForProduct(product){
     const c=String(product&&product.categoryId||"").toUpperCase();
     let base=null;
     if(c.includes("SEA")||c.includes("DENIZ"))base=CESNI_SAFETY_BASE.SEAFOOD;
     else if(c.includes("POUL")||c.includes("KANAT"))base=CESNI_SAFETY_BASE.POULTRY;
     else if(c.includes("MEAT")||c.includes("KIRMIZI"))base=CESNI_SAFETY_BASE.RED_MEAT_WHOLE;
     if(!base)return null;
     const name=[product&&product.name,product&&product.nameTr,product&&product.displayName,product&&product.scientificName].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
     const hazards=CESNI_PRODUCT_SAFETY_EVIDENCE.filter(x=>x.match.test(name)).map(x=>({name:x.hazard,level:x.level,source:x.source,note:x.note}));
     return {...base,hazards};
    }
    function cesniRecipeTechnicalGuide(recipe,selectedMaster,weightG,product){
     const master=selectedMaster||CESNI_METHOD_MASTER[cesniMethodKey(recipe&&recipe.sourceMethodName)||""]||null;
     const safe=cesniSafetyForProduct(product),productEvidence=cesniProductEvidence(product,master),ev=productEvidence[0]||null;
     const preparation=cesniProductPreparation(product,master,productEvidence);
     const processSteps=[];
     if(preparation.status==="DOGRULANMIS")processSteps.push({step:"URUNU_HAZIRLA",text:preparation.text,sourceId:preparation.sourceId});

     if(ev&&ev.application)processSteps.push({step:"PISIR",text:ev.application,sourceId:ev.sourceId});

     if(ev&&ev.finishing)processSteps.push({step:"BITIR_SERVIS",text:ev.finishing,sourceId:ev.sourceId});
     const safety=safe?{status:"DOGRULANMIS_RESMI_REFERANS",cookCoreC:safe.cookCoreC,cookHoldSec:safe.cookHoldSec||0,restMin:safe.restMin,measure:safe.measure,hazards:safe.hazards||[],generalControls:safe.generalControls||[],source:safe.source,sourceLabel:safe.sourceLabel||safe.source,note:"Gastronomik pi\u015fme hedefi ile resm\u00ee g\u0131da g\u00fcvenli\u011fi gereklili\u011fi ayr\u0131 de\u011ferlendirilir."}:{status:"ARASTIRMA_GEREKLI",note:"\u00dcr\u00fcn t\u00fcr\u00fcne ait g\u00fcvenlik kayd\u0131 do\u011frulanmadan say\u0131sal g\u00fcvenlik hedefi g\u00f6sterilmez."};
     const techniqueDossier=cesniTechniqueDossier(master);
     const approvedProcessSteps=processSteps.filter(x=>x&&x.text&&cesniGuideQaText(x.text).ok&&cesniProductAnatomyQa(product,x.text).ok);
     const approvedTechniqueDossier=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(techniqueDossier||{}).filter(([k,v])=>!["preparation","heatManagement","application","control","finishing","commonErrors"].includes(k)||!v||cesniGuideQaText(v).ok));
     const preQa={nonActionable:processSteps.filter(x=>!cesniGuideQaText(x.text).ok).map(x=>cesniGuideQaText(x.text).code),anatomy:processSteps.filter(x=>!cesniProductAnatomyQa(product,x.text).ok).map(x=>cesniProductAnatomyQa(product,x.text).code)};
     const qaProbe={processSteps,ingredients:cesniIngredientFlow(recipe),productEvidence,safety};
     const releaseQa=[...new Set([...cesniV29Qa(qaProbe),...preQa.nonActionable,...preQa.anatomy])];
     const publishable=preparation.status==="DOGRULANMIS"&&approvedProcessSteps.some(x=>x.step==="PISIR")&&safety.status!=="ARASTIRMA_GEREKLI"&&!releaseQa.includes("RECIPE_WITHOUT_EXECUTION_SEQUENCE")&&!releaseQa.includes("UNTRACEABLE_SOURCE")&&!preQa.nonActionable.length&&!preQa.anatomy.length;
     return {title:(recipe&&recipe.title)||"Kaynak re\u00e7etesi",recipeId:recipe&&recipe.id||null,productId:product&&product.id||null,methodId:master&&master.id||null,targetWeightG:weightG||1000,
      turkcePresentation:CESNI_TURKCE_ANLATIM_POLITIKASI,techniqueDossier,approvedTechniqueDossier,productPreparation:preparation,
      ingredients:qaProbe.ingredients,processSteps,approvedProcessSteps,safety,productEvidence,
      productPreparationMaster:{schema:CESNI_PRODUCT_PREPARATION_MASTER_SCHEMA,status:preparation.status,data:preparation},
      productTechniqueApplication:{schema:CESNI_PRODUCT_TECHNIQUE_APPLICATION_SCHEMA,status:(ev&&ev.application)?"DOGRULANMIS":"ARASTIRMA_GEREKLI",data:(ev&&ev.application)?{application:ev.application,sourceId:ev.sourceId}:null},
      recipeExecution:{schema:CESNI_RECIPE_EXECUTION_SCHEMA,status:processSteps.some(x=>x.step==="PISIR")?"DOGRULANMIS":"ARASTIRMA_GEREKLI",steps:processSteps},
      expertTips:[],expertTipPolicy:"\u015eef/uzman t\u00fcyosu yaln\u0131z do\u011fru \u00fcr\u00fcn + teknik + m\u00fcmk\u00fcnse re\u00e7ete ad\u0131m\u0131na kaynakla ba\u011flan\u0131r; kaynak yoksa t\u00fcyo \u00fcretilmez.",
      qa:preQa,releaseQa,publishable,
      yieldRecord:cesniYieldRecord(product,master),serviceProductionSchema:CESNI_SERVICE_PRODUCTION_EXECUTION_SCHEMA,
      evidence:"Re\u00e7ete bile\u015fimi kaynak kayd\u0131ndan gelir. \u00dcr\u00fcn-\u00f6zel haz\u0131rlama/pi\u015firme/bitiri\u015f kan\u0131t\u0131 yoksa kullan\u0131c\u0131ya ortak metin \u00fcretilmez.",evidenceFilter:CESNI_EVIDENCE_FILTER};
    }

    function cesniGuideSkeleton(product,method){
      const key=cesniMethodKey(method),master=key?CESNI_METHOD_MASTER[key]:null;
      const evidence=cesniProductEvidence(product,master)||[];
      const preparation=cesniProductPreparation(product,master,evidence);
      const productTechniqueApplication=evidence.find(x=>x&&x.application)||null;
      const sourceVerified=!!(method&&method.sourceVerifiedForProduct);
      const gates={product:true,method:!!master,sourceMethod:sourceVerified,preparation:preparation.status==="DOGRULANMIS",productTechnique:!!productTechniqueApplication,evidence:evidence.some(x=>x&&x.sourceId)};
      const complete=Object.values(gates).every(Boolean);
      const missing=Object.entries(gates).filter(([,ok])=>!ok).map(([k])=>k);
      return {guideId:"GUIDE-"+product.id+"-"+method.methodId,productId:product.id,methodId:method.methodId,methodMaster:master,
        status:complete?"GUIDE_READY":"GUIDE_INCOMPLETE",complete,qaCode:complete?null:"PRODUCT_METHOD_GUIDE_EMPTY",missing,gates,
        productPreparation:preparation,productTechniqueApplication:productTechniqueApplication?{status:"DOGRULANMIS",application:productTechniqueApplication.application,sourceId:productTechniqueApplication.sourceId,scope:productTechniqueApplication.scope||null}:{status:"ARASTIRMA_GEREKLI"},
        requiredFields:CESNI_GUIDE_REQUIRED_FIELDS,fieldLabels:CESNI_TR_FIELD_LABELS,activeModules:Object.fromEntries(CESNI_GUIDE_REQUIRED_FIELDS.map(f=>[f,cesniActiveModuleValue(f,master,method)])),genericTechniqueGuide:cesniTechniqueGenericGuide(master),technicalPlaybook:cesniPlaybook(master),techniqueDossier:cesniTechniqueDossier(master),turkcePresentation:CESNI_TURKCE_ANLATIM_POLITIKASI,ingredientRoleSchema:CESNI_INGREDIENT_ROLE_SCHEMA,processStepSchema:CESNI_PROCESS_STEP_SCHEMA,productionModes:Object.values(CESNI_PRODUCTION_MODES),
        evidencePolicy:{minimumTier:"A/B/C",noInventedTimeTemperature:true,noInventedFourthRecipe:true,productMethodEvidenceRequired:true},
        evidenceSources:Object.values(CESNI_EVIDENCE_SOURCES),productEvidence:evidence,yieldSchema:CESNI_YIELD_SCHEMA,safetyGates:CESNI_SAFETY_GATES,horecaSchema:CESNI_HORECA_SCHEMA};
    }

    function cesniEngineeringAudit(core){
     const issues=[]; const q=core&&core.qa||{};
     if(q.products!==CESNI_ENGINEERING_DECISIONS.productTarget)issues.push("PRODUCT_TARGET_MISMATCH");
     if(q.recipes!==CESNI_ENGINEERING_DECISIONS.recipeTarget)issues.push("RECIPE_TARGET_MISMATCH");
     if(q.productMethods!==CESNI_ENGINEERING_DECISIONS.methodsTarget)issues.push("METHOD_TARGET_MISMATCH");
     for(const k of ["duplicateProductIds","duplicateRecipeIds","orphanMethods","orphanRecipes","productsWithout3Methods","productsWithout4Recipes"])if(Number(q[k]||0)!==0)issues.push(k.toUpperCase());
     return {pass:issues.length===0,issues,targets:CESNI_ENGINEERING_DECISIONS,qa:q,sourceRegistryCount:CESNI_RESEARCH_REGISTRY.length};
    }
    function cesniSafetyProfile(product){
     const c=String(product&&product.categoryId||""); const allergens=[];
     if(c==="SEAFOOD")allergens.push("Balik/kabuklu/yumusakca turune gore alerjen bildirimi zorunlu kontrol");
     return {productId:product&&product.id||null,allergens,crossContamination:"Cig ve pisirilmis urun ekipmanini ayir; capraz bulasmayi engelle.",marination:"Cig urunu oda sicakliginda marine etme; soguk zinciri koru.",fabricationBlocked:true,evidence:["FDA_SEAFOOD_SAFE","TR_KODEKS_ALLERGEN"]};
    }
    function cesniEvidenceForContext(product,methodKey){
     const scopes=[String(product&&product.categoryId||""),String(methodKey||"").toUpperCase()];
     return CESNI_RESEARCH_REGISTRY.filter(x=>x.scope.some(s=>scopes.includes(s))||x.scope.includes("ALLERGEN")||x.scope.includes("PROCESS"));
    }
    // === /\u00c7E\u015eN\u0130 v4.3.0 M\u00dcHEND\u0130SL\u0130K / KAYNAK / RELEASE GATE ===
    let CESNI_DATA_CORE_CACHE = null;
    async function loadCesniDataCore(){
      if(CESNI_DATA_CORE_CACHE) return CESNI_DATA_CORE_CACHE;
      const stream=new Blob([b64Bytes(CESNI_DATA_CORE_GZIP_B64)]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("gzip"));
      const core=JSON.parse(await new Response(stream).text());
      const productById=new Map(core.products.map(x=>[x.id,x]));
      const productsByCategory=new Map();
      const methodsByProduct=new Map();
      const recipesByProduct=new Map(),recipesByProductMethod=new Map(),recipesByProductMasterMethod=new Map();
      const norm=s=>String(s||"").replace(/İ/g,'i').replace(/I/g,'ı').toLowerCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,"").replace(/[^a-z0-9\u00e7\u011f\u0131\u00f6\u015f\u00fc]+/g," ").trim();
      for(const p of core.products){if(!productsByCategory.has(p.categoryId))productsByCategory.set(p.categoryId,[]);productsByCategory.get(p.categoryId).push(p)}
      for(const rows of productsByCategory.values())rows.sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name,"tr"));
      for(const m of core.productMethods){if(!methodsByProduct.has(m.productId))methodsByProduct.set(m.productId,[]);methodsByProduct.get(m.productId).push(m)}
      for(const r of core.recipes){
        if(!recipesByProduct.has(r.productId))recipesByProduct.set(r.productId,[]);recipesByProduct.get(r.productId).push(r);
        const methods=methodsByProduct.get(r.productId)||[];
        // v2.6: Kaynak re\u00e7etede sourceMethodName varsa bu alan birincil kan\u0131tt\u0131r. Ba\u015fl\u0131k/profil yaln\u0131z
        // ikincil do\u011frulama i\u00e7indir. B\u00f6ylece "Izgara" kayd\u0131 "\u0131zgara" kaynak y\u00f6ntemiyle do\u011frudan ba\u011flan\u0131r.
        const sourceMethodText=norm(r.sourceMethodName||"");
        const recipeText=norm((r.title||"")+" "+(r.profile||"")+" "+(r.raw||""));
        let hit=null, linkStatus="METHOD_RESEARCH_REQUIRED";
        if(sourceMethodText){
          const exact=methods.filter(m=>norm(m.name)===sourceMethodText);
          if(exact.length===1){hit=exact[0];linkStatus="SOURCE_METHOD_EXACT";}
          else {
            const sourceMaster=cesniMethodKey(r.sourceMethodName||"");
            const masterHits=sourceMaster?methods.filter(m=>cesniMethodKey(m)===sourceMaster):[];
            if(masterHits.length===1){hit=masterHits[0];linkStatus="SOURCE_METHOD_MASTER";}
            else if(masterHits.length>1)linkStatus="AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE_METHOD";
          }
        }
        if(!hit){
          const titleMaster=cesniMethodKey(r.title||"");
          const titleHits=titleMaster?methods.filter(m=>cesniMethodKey(m)===titleMaster):[];
          if(titleHits.length===1){hit=titleHits[0];linkStatus="TITLE_METHOD_MASTER";}
          else if(titleHits.length>1)linkStatus="AMBIGUOUS_TITLE_METHOD";
        }
        if(!hit){
          const textHits=methods.filter(m=>{const mn=norm(m.name);return mn&&recipeText.includes(mn)});
          if(textHits.length===1){hit=textHits[0];linkStatus="TEXT_METHOD_MATCH";}
          else if(textHits.length>1)linkStatus="AMBIGUOUS_METHOD";
        }
        if(hit){
          r.methodId=hit.methodId;
          r.methodMasterId=cesniMethodKey(hit)||null;
          r.methodLinkStatus=linkStatus;
          const k=r.productId+"|"+hit.methodId;if(!recipesByProductMethod.has(k))recipesByProductMethod.set(k,[]);recipesByProductMethod.get(k).push(r);
          if(r.methodMasterId){const mk=r.productId+"|"+r.methodMasterId;if(!recipesByProductMasterMethod.has(mk))recipesByProductMasterMethod.set(mk,[]);recipesByProductMasterMethod.get(mk).push(r)}
        } else {r.methodId=null;r.methodMasterId=null;r.methodLinkStatus=linkStatus}
      }
      CESNI_DATA_CORE_CACHE={core,productById,productsByCategory,methodsByProduct,recipesByProduct,recipesByProductMethod,recipesByProductMasterMethod};
      return CESNI_DATA_CORE_CACHE;
    }
    async function cesniCoreApi(url){
      const db=await loadCesniDataCore();
      const action=(url.searchParams.get("action")||"status").toLowerCase();
      if(action==="status"){const audit=cesniEngineeringAudit(db.core);return responseJSON({ok:true,version:CESNI_VERSION,mode:"STRICT_PRODUCT_METHOD_GUIDE_CHAIN_QA_TR",releaseGate:audit.pass?"PASS":"BLOCKED",audit,qa:db.core.qa,categories:db.core.categories,sourceRegistryCount:CESNI_RESEARCH_REGISTRY.length});}
      if(action==="products"){const category=(url.searchParams.get("category")||"").toUpperCase();const rows=category?(db.productsByCategory.get(category)||[]):db.core.products;return responseJSON({ok:true,count:rows.length,products:rows})}
      if(action==="methods"){const productId=url.searchParams.get("productId")||"";if(!db.productById.has(productId))return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND"},404);const sourceRows=db.methodsByProduct.get(productId)||[];const seen=new Set(),verifiedRows=[];for(const sm of sourceRows){const key=cesniMethodKey(sm);if(!key||seen.has(key))continue;seen.add(key);const master=CESNI_METHOD_MASTER[key];verifiedRows.push({methodId:"TECH_"+key,name:(master&&master.name)||sm.name,masterId:key,family:(master&&master.family)||"SOURCE",sourceVerifiedForProduct:true,sourceMethodId:sm.methodId,sourceMethodName:sm.name,techniqueLibrary:false})}const libraryRows=Object.values(CESNI_METHOD_MASTER).map(x=>({methodId:"TECH_"+x.id,name:x.name,masterId:x.id,family:x.family,sourceVerifiedForProduct:seen.has(x.id),techniqueLibrary:true}));return responseJSON({ok:true,product:db.productById.get(productId),count:verifiedRows.length,sourceVerifiedCount:sourceRows.length,methods:verifiedRows,sourceMethods:sourceRows,techniqueLibrary:libraryRows})}
      if(action==="techniques")return responseJSON({ok:true,count:Object.keys(CESNI_METHOD_MASTER).length,techniques:Object.values(CESNI_METHOD_MASTER)});
      if(action==="guide"){const productId=url.searchParams.get("productId")||"",methodId=url.searchParams.get("methodId")||"";const product=db.productById.get(productId);if(!product)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND"},404);let method=(db.methodsByProduct.get(productId)||[]).find(x=>x.methodId===methodId);if(!method&&methodId.startsWith("TECH_")){const key=methodId.slice(5),master=CESNI_METHOD_MASTER[key];if(master)method={methodId,name:master.name,masterId:key,family:master.family,techniqueLibrary:true,sourceVerifiedForProduct:(db.methodsByProduct.get(productId)||[]).some(x=>cesniMethodKey(x)===key)}}if(!method)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"PRODUCT_METHOD_NOT_FOUND"},404);const guide=cesniGuideSkeleton(product,method);const gg=/** @type {any} */(guide.genericTechniqueGuide||{});const presentation={approvedGeneralSteps:(gg.applicationSteps||[]).filter(x=>cesniGuideQaText(x).ok),industrialEquipment:(gg.industrialEquipment||[]),guideStatus:guide.status,complete:guide.complete,missing:guide.missing};return responseJSON({ok:true,version:CESNI_VERSION,product,method,guide,presentation,status:guide.status,complete:guide.complete,missing:guide.missing});}
      if(action==="qa"){const productId=url.searchParams.get("productId")||"";const product=db.productById.get(productId);if(!product)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND"},404);return responseJSON({ok:true,qa:cesniQaForProduct(product,db)});}
      if(action==="research-sources"){const productId=url.searchParams.get("productId")||"",methodId=url.searchParams.get("methodId")||"";const product=db.productById.get(productId);if(!product)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND"},404);const methodKey=methodId.startsWith("TECH_")?methodId.slice(5):cesniMethodKey((db.methodsByProduct.get(productId)||[]).find(x=>x.methodId===methodId))||"";return responseJSON({ok:true,version:CESNI_VERSION,productId,methodId,methodKey,research:cesniExternalResearchFor(product,methodKey)});}
      if(action==="evidence"){const productId=url.searchParams.get("productId")||"",methodId=url.searchParams.get("methodId")||"";const product=db.productById.get(productId);if(!product)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND"},404);const master=methodId.startsWith("TECH_")?CESNI_METHOD_MASTER[methodId.slice(5)]:CESNI_METHOD_MASTER[cesniMethodKey((db.methodsByProduct.get(productId)||[]).find(x=>x.methodId===methodId))||""];return responseJSON({ok:true,productId,methodId,evidence:cesniProductEvidence(product,master)});}
      if(action==="yield")return responseJSON({ok:true,schema:CESNI_YIELD_SCHEMA});
      if(action==="safety")return responseJSON({ok:true,gates:CESNI_SAFETY_GATES});
      if(action==="horeca")return responseJSON({ok:true,schema:CESNI_HORECA_SCHEMA});
      if(action==="recommendations"){const productId=url.searchParams.get("productId")||"",methodId=url.searchParams.get("methodId")||"";const product=db.productById.get(productId);if(!product)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND"},404);let selectedMethod=null,sourceMethodId=methodId;if(methodId.startsWith("TECH_")){selectedMethod=CESNI_METHOD_MASTER[methodId.slice(5)]||null;const sm=(db.methodsByProduct.get(productId)||[]).find(m=>cesniMethodKey(m)===methodId.slice(5));sourceMethodId=sm&&sm.methodId||"";}else{const sm=(db.methodsByProduct.get(productId)||[]).find(m=>m.methodId===methodId);selectedMethod=CESNI_METHOD_MASTER[cesniMethodKey(sm)||""]||null;}if(methodId&&!selectedMethod)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"PRODUCT_METHOD_NOT_FOUND"},404);const selectedMasterId=selectedMethod&&selectedMethod.id||"";
        let rows=(methodId?(methodId.startsWith("TECH_")?(db.recipesByProductMasterMethod.get(productId+"|"+methodId.slice(5))||[]):(db.recipesByProductMethod.get(productId+"|"+methodId)||[])):(db.recipesByProduct.get(productId)||[])).slice().sort((a,b)=>(a.ordinal||0)-(b.ordinal||0)).slice(0,CESNI_RECIPE_POLICY.targetPerProduct);
        for(const r of rows)if(r.productId!==productId)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"RECIPE_CONTEXT_MISMATCH"},409);
        const productMethods=db.methodsByProduct.get(productId)||[];
        const recipeTechnicalGuides=rows.map(r=>{const own=productMethods.find(m=>m.methodId===r.methodId)||selectedMethod;return cesniRecipeTechnicalGuide(r,own,1000,product)});
        const selectedTechniqueGuide=cesniGuideSkeleton(product,{methodId:methodId||("TECH_"+selectedMasterId),name:selectedMethod&&selectedMethod.name||"",sourceVerifiedForProduct:(db.methodsByProduct.get(productId)||[]).some(m=>cesniMethodKey(m)===selectedMasterId)});

    function b64Bytes(s){const b=atob(s),u=new Uint8Array(b.length);for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)u[i]=b.charCodeAt(i);return u}

    const PROFIT_RADAR_V5160 = Object.freeze({

        OTEL:{label:"Otel",purchaseGuide:.36,fixedGuide:.34},

    function radarNumber(v){if(typeof v==="number")return Number.isFinite(v)?v:0;let s=String(v??"").trim().replace(/\s/g,"");if(s.includes(","))s=s.replace(/\./g,"").replace(",",".");else if(/^[+-]?\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{3})+$/.test(s))s=s.replace(/\./g,"");const n=Number(s);return Number.isFinite(n)?n:0}
    function radarRound(n){return Math.round((Number(n)||0)*100)/100}
    function radarType(v){const k=String(v||"").trim().toLocaleUpperCase("tr-TR");return PROFIT_RADAR_V5160.types[k]?k:"DIGER"}
    function radarId(){return "PR-"+crypto.randomUUID().slice(0,8).toUpperCase()}
    function calculateProfitRadarV5160(p={}){
      const revenue=radarNumber(p.monthlyRevenue),purchase=radarNumber(p.monthlyPurchase),fixed=radarNumber(p.monthlyFixed);
      if(revenue<=0)throw new Error("Ayl\u0131k ciro s\u0131f\u0131rdan b\u00fcy\u00fck olmal\u0131d\u0131r.");
      if(purchase<0||fixed<0)throw new Error("Giderler negatif olamaz.");
      if(revenue>PROFIT_RADAR_V5160.maxMonthly||purchase>PROFIT_RADAR_V5160.maxMonthly||fixed>PROFIT_RADAR_V5160.maxMonthly)throw new Error("Girilen tutar izin verilen analiz s\u0131n\u0131r\u0131n\u0131 a\u015f\u0131yor.");
      if(purchase+fixed>revenue*3)throw new Error("Rakamlar\u0131 kontrol edin; gider toplam\u0131 cironun \u00fc\u00e7 kat\u0131n\u0131 a\u015f\u0131yor.");
      const typeKey=radarType(p.businessType),guide=PROFIT_RADAR_V5160.types[typeKey];
      const purchaseRatio=purchase/revenue,fixedRatio=fixed/revenue,totalRatio=(purchase+fixed)/revenue;
      const purchaseExcess=Math.max(0,purchaseRatio-guide.purchaseGuide),fixedExcess=Math.max(0,fixedRatio-guide.fixedGuide);
      let purchasingOpportunity=Math.min(purchase*.035,revenue*Math.min(.010,Math.max(.0025,purchaseExcess*.18)));
      if(purchaseRatio<=guide.purchaseGuide)purchasingOpportunity=purchase*.005;
      let operationOpportunity=Math.min(fixed*.015,revenue*Math.min(.004,Math.max(.001,fixedExcess*.08)));
      if(fixedRatio<=guide.fixedGuide)operationOpportunity=fixed*.0025;
      const monthlyMid=Math.max(0,purchasingOpportunity+operationOpportunity);
      const annualMid=Math.min(monthlyMid*12,revenue*12*.015),annualLow=annualMid*.55,annualHigh=annualMid*1.35;
      let opportunities=[];
      if(purchaseRatio>guide.purchaseGuide)opportunities.push({code:"PURCHASE",title:"Sat\u0131n alma optimizasyonu",level:purchaseRatio>guide.purchaseGuide+.08?"Y\u00dcKSEK":"ORTA",detail:"Sat\u0131n alma oran\u0131n\u0131z \u00f6n analiz rehberinin \u00fczerinde g\u00f6r\u00fcn\u00fcyor. Tedarik, gramaj ve fiyat kar\u015f\u0131la\u015ft\u0131rmas\u0131 \u00f6nerilir."});
      else opportunities.push({code:"PURCHASE_CONTROL",title:"Sat\u0131n alma kontrol\u00fc",level:"D\u00dc\u015e\u00dcK",detail:"Sat\u0131n alma oran\u0131n\u0131z kontroll\u00fc g\u00f6r\u00fcn\u00fcyor; \u00fcr\u00fcn baz\u0131nda do\u011frulama yine de fayda sa\u011flayabilir."});
      if(fixedRatio>guide.fixedGuide)opportunities.push({code:"FIXED",title:"Sabit gider y\u00fck\u00fc",level:fixedRatio>guide.fixedGuide+.08?"Y\u00dcKSEK":"ORTA",detail:"Sabit giderlerin ciro i\u00e7indeki pay\u0131 dikkat gerektiriyor. Sat\u0131\u015f ba\u015f\u0131na gider da\u011f\u0131l\u0131m\u0131 incelenmeli."});
      if(totalRatio>=.80)opportunities.push({code:"MARGIN",title:"K\u00e2r g\u00fcvenlik alan\u0131",level:totalRatio>=.95?"Y\u00dcKSEK":"ORTA",detail:"Sat\u0131n alma ve sabit gider toplam\u0131, cironun b\u00fcy\u00fck b\u00f6l\u00fcm\u00fcn\u00fc kullan\u0131yor. Detayl\u0131 COST analizi \u00f6nerilir."});
      else opportunities.push({code:"MARGIN_CONTROL",title:"K\u00e2r marj\u0131 do\u011frulamas\u0131",level:"D\u00dc\u015e\u00dcK",detail:"Genel g\u00f6r\u00fcn\u00fcm dengeli; fire, i\u015f\u00e7ilik ve de\u011fi\u015fken giderler eklenerek ger\u00e7ek k\u00e2r do\u011frulanmal\u0131d\u0131r."});
      if(opportunities.length<3)opportunities.push({code:"WASTE_CHECK",title:"Fire ve de\u011fi\u015fken gider kontrol\u00fc",level:"D\u00dc\u015e\u00dcK",detail:"\u00dc\u00e7 \u00f6zet rakam fireyi tek ba\u015f\u0131na g\u00f6stermez. Stok, porsiyon, i\u015f\u00e7ilik ve de\u011fi\u015fken giderler detayl\u0131 Check-Up ile do\u011frulanmal\u0131d\u0131r."});
      opportunities=opportunities.slice(0,3);
      return {success:true,release:"5.16.0",analysisId:radarId(),businessType:typeKey,businessTypeLabel:guide.label,
        ratios:{purchase:radarRound(purchaseRatio*100),fixed:radarRound(fixedRatio*100),combined:radarRound(totalRatio*100)},
        potential:{annualLow:radarRound(annualLow),annualMid:radarRound(annualMid),annualHigh:radarRound(annualHigh)},
        opportunities,
        disclaimer:"Bu sonu\u00e7, girilen \u00fc\u00e7 \u00f6zet veri ve muhafazak\u00e2r \u00f6n analiz varsay\u0131mlar\u0131na dayan\u0131r; kesin kazan\u00e7 veya tasarruf taahh\u00fcd\u00fc de\u011fildir. Stok, fire, i\u015f\u00e7ilik, vergi ve \u00fcr\u00fcn fiyatlar\u0131 incelenmeden kesin sonu\u00e7 verilemez."};
    }

    const CESNI_MOTOR_SCENARIOS={full:'Ba\u015ftan sona profesyonel pi\u015firme k\u0131lavuzu olu\u015ftur.',temp:'Gramaj, kal\u0131nl\u0131k ve y\u00f6ntem ba\u011flam\u0131nda yaln\u0131z kaynakla do\u011frulanm\u0131\u015f s\u0131cakl\u0131k ve s\u00fcreleri de\u011ferlendir.',pro:'Profesyonel haz\u0131rl\u0131k, ekipman, \u0131s\u0131 y\u00f6netimi, yerle\u015ftirme, \u00e7evirme/hareket ve pi\u015fme kontrol tekniklerini de\u011ferlendir.',errors:'Bu \u00fcr\u00fcn ve y\u00f6ntemde kritik hatalar\u0131, nedenlerini ve \u00f6nleme kontrollerini de\u011ferlendir.',sources:'A/B/C/D kaynak kan\u0131tlar\u0131n\u0131, ortak noktalar\u0131, ayr\u0131\u015fmalar\u0131 ve \u00e7\u00f6z\u00fclemeyen \u00e7eli\u015fkileri g\u00f6ster.',all:'\u00d6n haz\u0131rl\u0131k, ekipman, \u0131s\u0131, uygulama, pi\u015fme kontrol\u00fc, dinlendirme, kritik hatalar, profesyonel teknikler, g\u00fcvenlik ve kaynak kan\u0131tlar\u0131n\u0131 birlikte de\u011ferlendir.'};
    function selectedMethodName(){let m=state.methods.find(x=>x.methodId===state.methodId);return m?m.name:(state.methodId||'Y\u00f6ntem se\u00e7ilmedi')}

    function newContextId(){return 'CTX_'+Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7).toUpperCase()}
    function contextPassport(){if(!state.contextId)state.contextId=newContextId();return {contextId:state.contextId,productId:state.productId||null,methodId:state.methodId||null,weightG:Math.max(1,+weight.value||1000),recipeId:(state.recommendation&&state.recommendation.recipes&&state.recommendation.recipes[state.selectedRecipeIndex]||{}).recipeId||null,rndTestId:state.selectedRndTestId||null}}
    function detectCesniIntent(text){let q=String(text||'').replace(/İ/g,'i').replace(/I/g,'ı').toLowerCase(),i='TECHNIQUE';if(/sert|kuru|yap\u0131\u015f|yapis|yan|da\u011f\u0131l|dagil|kesil|olmad\u0131|olmadi|hata|neden/.test(q))i='DIAGNOSE';else if(/maliyet|cost|fiyat|k\u00e2r|kar /.test(q))i='COST';else if(/re\u00e7ete|recete|\u00e7e\u015fni|cesni|baharat|sos|marine/.test(q))i='RECIPE';else if(/kaynak|kan\u0131t|kanit|ara\u015ft\u0131r|arastir|profesyonel/.test(q))i='RESEARCH';else if(/g\u00fcven|guven|alerjen|hijyen|tehlike/.test(q))i='SAFETY';else if(/ar-ge|arge|geli\u015ftir|gelistir|deneme/.test(q))i='RND';return i}
    function orchestrateCesni(text){let intent=detectCesniIntent(text),eng=['PRODUCT','QA'];if(intent==='DIAGNOSE')eng.push('DIAGNOSE','TECHNIQUE','RESEARCH','EVIDENCE','SAFETY');else if(intent==='COST')eng.push('COST','RECIPE','QA');else if(intent==='RECIPE')eng.push('RECIPE','SEASONING','EVIDENCE','SAFETY');else if(intent==='RESEARCH')eng.push('RESEARCH','EVIDENCE','TECHNIQUE','SAFETY');else if(intent==='SAFETY')eng.push('SAFETY','EVIDENCE');else if(intent==='RND')eng.push('RND','RECIPE','SENSORY','EVIDENCE');else eng.push('TECHNIQUE','RESEARCH','EVIDENCE','SAFETY');if(state.motorScenario==='all')eng.push('RECIPE','DIAGNOSE');state.intent=intent;state.activeEngines=[...new Set(eng)];return {intent,engines:state.activeEngines,passport:contextPassport()}}
    function revealBackend(id){['guidePanel','recipePanel','rndPanel','sensoryPanel'].forEach(x=>{let e=$(x);if(e)e.classList.toggle('revealed',x===id)});let e=$(id);if(e){e.classList.remove('hidden');e.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'})}}
    function composeMotorPrompt(){let p=state.product?trName(state.product):'',w=Math.max(1,+weight.value||1000),m=selectedMethodName(),q=motorQuestion.value.trim(),scenario=CESNI_MOTOR_SCENARIOS[state.motorScenario]||CESNI_MOTOR_SCENARIOS.full;return '\u00dcR\u00dcN: '+p+' | PRODUCT_ID: '+(state.productId||'YOK')+' | GRAMAJ: '+w+' g | Y\u00d6NTEM: '+m+' | METHOD_ID: '+(state.methodId||'YOK')+'. G\u00d6REV: '+scenario+(q?' KULLANICI SORUSU: '+q+'.':'')+' Re\u00e7ete/sos/baharat gramaj\u0131 \u00fcretme. Gastronomik hedef ile g\u0131da g\u00fcvenli\u011fi minimumunu ay\u0131r. Her kritik s\u00fcre/s\u0131cakl\u0131k iddias\u0131 kan\u0131t gerektirir. A/B/C/D kaynak s\u0131n\u0131f\u0131n\u0131 g\u00f6ster. \u00c7eli\u015fki varsa i\u015faretle. Kan\u0131t yoksa tahmin etme.'}
    function motorCard(title,body){return '<div class="motorCard"><b>'+esc(title)+'</b>'+body+'</div>'}

    function cesniNorm(s){return String(s||'').replace(/İ/g,'i').replace(/I/g,'ı').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/[^a-z0-9\u00e7\u011f\u0131\u00f6\u015f\u00fc\s-]/gi,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()}
    function inferWeightFromQuestion(q){let m=String(q||'').match(/(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*(kg|kilogram|g|gr|gram)\b/i);if(!m)return null;let n=parseFloat(m[1].replace(',','.'));if(!Number.isFinite(n)||n<=0)return null;return /kg|kilogram/i.test(m[2])?Math.round(n*1000):Math.round(n)}
    function inferMethodId(q,methods){let n=cesniNorm(q),aliases=[['\u0131zgara','izgara'],['tava','tava'],['f\u0131r\u0131n','firin'],['buhar','buhar'],['ha\u015flama','haslama'],['ha\u015fla','hasla'],['sote','sote'],['airfryer','airfryer'],['air fryer','air fryer']];for(const [raw,norm] of aliases){if(n.includes(norm)){let hit=(methods||[]).find(x=>cesniNorm((x.name||'')+' '+(x.methodId||'')).includes(norm));if(hit)return hit.methodId}}return null}
    async function resolveMotorContextFromQuestion(){
      let q=motorQuestion.value.trim(), nq=cesniNorm(q), wg=inferWeightFromQuestion(q); if(wg) weight.value=wg;
      if(state.productId && state.methodId) return true;
      let best=null,bestCat=null;
      const cats=[...category.options].map(o=>o.value);
      for(const cid of cats){
        let rows=(cid===state.categoryId&&state.products.length)?state.products:(await api('action=products&category='+encodeURIComponent(cid))).products;
        for(const p of rows){
          let names=[trName(p),p.nameEn,p.nameOriginal].filter(Boolean).map(cesniNorm).filter(Boolean);
          let score=0;
          for(const name of names){
            if(!name)continue;
            if(nq===name)score=Math.max(score,1000+name.length);
            else if(nq.includes(name))score=Math.max(score,800+name.length);
            else {
              let toks=name.split(' ').filter(x=>x.length>2);
              let hit=toks.filter(t=>nq.includes(t)).length;
              if(hit)score=Math.max(score,hit*100+name.length);
            }
          }
          if(!best||score>best.score) if(score>0) best={p,score,rows},bestCat=cid;
        }
      }
      if(!best){
        motorResult.innerHTML='<div class="warn"><b>\u00dcr\u00fcn\u00fc anlayamad\u0131m.</b> Sorunu \u00fcr\u00fcn ad\u0131yla yaz\u0131n. \u00d6rnek: \u201c250 g levre\u011fi nas\u0131l pi\u015fireyim?\u201d veya \u201cBonfilem sert oldu.\u201d</div>';
        return false;
      }
      category.value=bestCat; state.categoryId=bestCat; state.products=best.rows; renderProducts();
      await selectProduct(best.p.id);
      let explicit=inferMethodId(q,state.methods);
      let chosen=explicit||(state.methods||[]).find(x=>x.sourceVerifiedForProduct)||(state.methods||[])[0];
      if(!chosen){
        motorResult.innerHTML='<div class="warn"><b>'+esc(trName(state.product))+'</b> bulundu ancak do\u011frulanm\u0131\u015f pi\u015firme y\u00f6ntemi bulunamad\u0131. Tahmini y\u00f6ntem \u00fcretilmedi.</div>';
        return false;
      }
      await selectMethod(chosen.methodId||chosen);
      return true;
    }

    function techniqueSection(title,body,cls){
      if(!body||!String(body).trim())return '';
      return '<section class="deepTech '+(cls||'')+'"><h3>'+esc(title)+'</h3><div>'+body+'</div></section>';
    }
    function extractGuideFragments(){
      let root=guideContent, out={intro:'',prep:'',equipment:'',heat:'',application:'',control:'',rest:'',errors:'',pro:'',safety:''};
      if(!root)return out;
      let blocks=[...root.querySelectorAll('h2,h3,h4,p,li,div')];
      const map=[
        ['prep',/\u00f6n haz\u0131rl|haz\u0131rl\u0131k|temiz|kurula|\u00e7\u00f6z\u00fcnd\u00fcr|ay\u0131kl|fileto|deri|kesim/i],
        ['equipment',/ekipman|tava|\u0131zgara|f\u0131r\u0131n|tepsi|termometre|b\u0131\u00e7ak/i],
        ['heat',/\u0131s\u0131|s\u0131cakl\u0131k|\u00f6n \u0131s\u0131t|ate\u015f|ocak/i],
        ['control',/pi\u015fti|kontrol|i\u00e7 s\u0131cak|\u00e7ekirdek|termometre|doneness/i],
        ['rest',/dinlen|beklet|servis \u00f6ncesi/i],
        ['errors',/hata|ka\u00e7\u0131n|yapmay\u0131n|risk|yap\u0131\u015f|kuruma|sert/i],
        ['pro',/profesyonel|\u015fef|ipucu|teknik|p\u00fcf/i],
        ['safety',/g\u00fcvenlik|g\u0131da g\u00fcven|alerjen|hijyen|\u00e7apraz|saklama/i]
      ];
      let seen=new Set();
      for(const el of blocks){
        let tx=(el.innerText||'').trim(); if(!tx||tx.length<12||seen.has(tx))continue; seen.add(tx);
        let key=null;
        for(const [k,rx] of map){if(rx.test(tx)){key=k;break}}
        if(!key)key='application';
        out[key]+='<p>'+esc(tx)+'</p>';
      }
      return out;
    }
    function buildDeepTechniqueAnswer(orchestration){

      html+=techniqueSection('1 \u00b7 \u00dcr\u00fcn\u00fc Tan\u0131',f.intro||'<p>'+esc(product)+' i\u00e7in se\u00e7ili y\u00f6ntem: '+esc(method)+'.</p>');

      html+=techniqueSection('7 \u00b7 Pi\u015fme Kontrol\u00fc',f.control||'<p>Pi\u015fme kontrol\u00fc i\u00e7in do\u011frulanm\u0131\u015f \u00fcr\u00fcn kayd\u0131 bekleniyor.</p>','needEvidence');
      html+=techniqueSection('8 \u00b7 Dinlendirme ve Servis',f.rest||'<p>Bu y\u00f6ntem i\u00e7in do\u011frulanm\u0131\u015f dinlendirme gereksinimi varsa burada g\u00f6sterilir.</p>','needEvidence');
      html+=techniqueSection('9 \u00b7 Kritik Hatalar',f.errors||'<p>\u00dcr\u00fcn-spesifik hata kay\u0131tlar\u0131 ara\u015ft\u0131rma katman\u0131nda tutulur; kan\u0131ts\u0131z hata listesi \u00fcretilmez.</p>','needEvidence');
      html+=techniqueSection('10 \u00b7 Profesyonel Teknikler',f.pro||'<p>Profesyonel kaynaklarla do\u011frulanm\u0131\u015f teknikler tamamland\u0131k\u00e7a burada g\u00f6r\u00fcn\u00fcr.</p>','needEvidence');
      html+=techniqueSection('11 \u00b7 G\u0131da G\u00fcvenli\u011fi',f.safety||'<p>G\u00fcvenlik minimumlar\u0131 gastronomik hedeflerden ayr\u0131 de\u011ferlendirilir.</p>');
      html+='<details class="evidenceDisclosure"><summary>Kan\u0131t durumunu g\u00f6ster</summary><p><b>'+esc(state.evidenceState)+'</b> \u00b7 Kaynak kay\u0131tlar\u0131 ziyaret\u00e7i ekran\u0131nda gizlidir. \u00c7E\u015eN\u0130 yaln\u0131z do\u011frulama sonucunu kullan\u0131r.</p></details>';
      return html;
    }

    async function runCesniMotor(){
      motorAsk.disabled=true; motorAsk.textContent='\u00c7E\u015eN\u0130 \u00c7ALI\u015eIYOR...';
      motorResult.innerHTML='<div class="motorContext"><b>\u00c7E\u015eN\u0130 soruyu analiz ediyor.</b><br>\u00dcr\u00fcn, gramaj, y\u00f6ntem, kan\u0131t ve gerekli uzman motorlar arka planda haz\u0131rlan\u0131yor.</div>';
      try{
        let ready=await resolveMotorContextFromQuestion(); if(!ready)return;
        refreshMotorContext();
        let orchestration=orchestrateCesni((motorQuestion.value||'')+' '+(CESNI_MOTOR_SCENARIOS[state.motorScenario]||''));
        state.motorLastPrompt=composeMotorPrompt();
        let guideHtml=guideContent?guideContent.innerHTML.trim():'';
        let guideText=guideContent?guideContent.innerText.trim():'';
        let rec=state.recommendation||{};
        let verified=!!(guideText&&!/do\u011frulamas\u0131 tamamlan\u0131yor|do\u011frulanmad\u0131/i.test(guideText));
        state.evidenceState=verified?'SUPPORTED':'INSUFFICIENT';
        let intentLabel={TECHNIQUE:'Pi\u015firme Tekni\u011fi',DIAGNOSE:'Sorun Te\u015fhisi',COST:'Maliyet',RECIPE:'Re\u00e7ete',RESEARCH:'Kaynak Ara\u015ft\u0131rmas\u0131',SAFETY:'G\u0131da G\u00fcvenli\u011fi',RND:'AR-GE'}[orchestration.intent]||orchestration.intent;
        let answer='<div class="lock" style="background:#102f45;color:#fff;border-left-color:#e8b94f"><b>'+esc(trName(state.product))+' \u00b7 '+Math.max(1,+weight.value||1000)+' g \u00b7 '+esc(selectedMethodName())+'</b><br><span class="confidence">'+esc(state.evidenceState)+'</span> <span class="intentBadge">'+esc(intentLabel)+'</span></div>';
        if(orchestration.intent==='COST'){
          answer+='<div class="guide" style="background:#fff;color:#10283a"><h3>COST i\u00e7in ba\u011flam haz\u0131r</h3><p>\u00dcr\u00fcn ve \u00e7al\u0131\u015fma ba\u011flam\u0131 olu\u015fturuldu. Fiyat uydurulmadan COST merkezine aktar\u0131labilir.</p><button class="askBtn" onclick="location.href=\\'/cost\\'">COST Merkezini A\u00e7</button></div>';
        } else if(orchestration.intent==='RECIPE'){
          answer+='<div class="guide" style="background:#fff;color:#10283a"><h3>Do\u011frulanm\u0131\u015f re\u00e7eteler</h3><p>'+esc(rec.recipeCount||0)+'/4 kaynak re\u00e7etesi bulundu. Eksik re\u00e7ete varsa uydurulmaz.</p><button class="askBtn" onclick="revealBackend(\\'recipePanel\\')">Re\u00e7eteleri A\u00e7</button></div>';
        } else {
          answer+='<div class="guide deepGuide" style="background:#fff;color:#10283a">'+buildDeepTechniqueAnswer(orchestration)+'</div>';
        }
        answer+='<div class="motorQuick"><button type="button" onclick="revealBackend(\\'recipePanel\\')">4 Re\u00e7ete</button><button type="button" onclick="revealBackend(\\'guidePanel\\')">Teknik Kay\u0131t</button><button type="button" onclick="location.href=\\'/api/cesni/source\\'">Kaynaklar</button><button type="button" onclick="revealBackend(\\'rndPanel\\')">AR-GE</button><button type="button" onclick="location.href=\\'/cost\\'">COST</button></div>';
        motorResult.innerHTML=answer;
        motorResult.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
      }catch(e){
        console.error('CESNI_MOTOR_ERROR',e);
        motorResult.innerHTML='<div class="warn"><b>\u00c7E\u015eN\u0130 i\u015flemi tamamlayamad\u0131.</b> '+esc(e.message||e)+'</div>';
      }finally{
        motorAsk.disabled=false; motorAsk.textContent='\u2726 \u00c7E\u015eN\u0130\\'YE SOR';
      }
    }

    function initCesniMotor(){document.querySelectorAll('.scenario').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{document.querySelectorAll('.scenario').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b));state.motorScenario=b.dataset.scenario;motorQuestion.placeholder=CESNI_MOTOR_SCENARIOS[state.motorScenario]}));document.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{let q=b.dataset.q||'';motorQuestion.value=(motorQuestion.value.trim()?motorQuestion.value.trim()+' ':'')+q;motorQuestion.focus()}));motorAsk.addEventListener('click',runCesniMotor)}
    initCesniMotor();
    buildSensoryFields();
    boot();
    </script></body></html>`;
