    async function sendBoundEmail(env, message){
      if(!env||!env.EMAIL||typeof env.EMAIL.send!=="function")return null;
      const cfg=mailConfig(env); if(!cfg.to||!cfg.from)throw new Error("EMAIL_ADDRESS_NOT_CONFIGURED");
      const from=safeMailHeader(cfg.from),to=safeMailHeader(message.to||env.ADMIN_MAIL_TO||cfg.to),replyTo=safeMailHeader(message.replyTo);
      if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(from)||!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(to)||!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(replyTo))throw new Error("EMAIL_ADDRESS_NOT_CONFIGURED");
      const result=await env.EMAIL.send({to,from,replyTo,subject:safeMailHeader(message.subject).slice(0,180),text:String(message.text||""),html:String(message.html||"")});
      return result||{messageId:null};
    }

    async function memberCommerceQuoteAPI(request, env) {

      let body;

      const contentType=String(request.headers.get("content-type")||"").toLowerCase();
      const contentLength=Number(request.headers.get("content-length")||0);
      if(!contentType.includes("application/json"))return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE",message:"Teklif verisi JSON bi\u00e7iminde g\u00f6nderilmelidir."},415);
      if(contentLength>100000)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE",message:"Teklif verisi izin verilen boyutu a\u015f\u0131yor."},413);

      try {
        const raw=await request.text();if(new TextEncoder().encode(raw).byteLength>100000)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE"},413);body=JSON.parse(raw);
      } catch {
        return responseJSON(
          {
            ok: false,
            error: "INVALID_JSON",
            message: "Teklif verisi okunamad\u0131."
          },
          400
        );
      }

      const customer = body && body.customer ? body.customer : {name:[body&&body.firstName,body&&body.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(" "),business:body&&body.businessName,phone:body&&body.phone,email:body&&body.email};

      const products =
        body && Array.isArray(body.products)
          ? body.products
          : [];
      if (!products.length) return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"EMPTY_QUOTE",message:"Teklif listesinde \u00fcr\u00fcn bulunmuyor."},400);

      const name =
        String(customer.name || "").trim();

      const business =
        String(customer.business || "").trim();

      const phone =
        String(customer.phone || "").trim();

      const email =
        String(customer.email || "").trim();

      if (
        !name ||
        !business ||
        !phone ||
        !email
      ) {
        return responseJSON(
          {
            ok: false,
            error: "MISSING_FIELDS",
            message: "Zorunlu bilgiler eksik."
          },
          400
        );
      }

      const consentOk=body&&((body.consent&&body.consent.kvkk===true)||body.kvkkAcknowledged===true);
      if(!consentOk)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"KVKK_ACK_REQUIRED",message:"KVKK Ayd\u0131nlatma Metni bilgilendirmesi onaylanmal\u0131d\u0131r."},400);
      const phoneDigits=phone.replace(/\D/g,"");
      if(name.length<3||name.length>120||business.length<2||business.length>160||phone.length>30||email.length>160)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"INVALID_FIELDS",message:"Ad, i\u015fletme ve ileti\u015fim alanlar\u0131n\u0131n uzunluklar\u0131n\u0131 kontrol edin."},400);
      if(!/^\+?[0-9 ()-]+$/.test(phone)||phoneDigits.length<10||phoneDigits.length>15)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"INVALID_PHONE",message:"Ge\u00e7erli bir telefon numaras\u0131 girin."},400);
      if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(email))return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"INVALID_EMAIL",message:"Ge\u00e7erli bir e-posta adresi girin."},400);
      if(products.length>100)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"TOO_MANY_PRODUCTS",message:"Tek seferde en fazla 100 \u00fcr\u00fcn g\u00f6nderilebilir."},400);
      const storefrontResponse=await commerceRoute(new Request(new URL('/api/storefront-v2',request.url),{headers:{accept:'application/json'}}),env);
      if(!storefrontResponse||!storefrontResponse.ok)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE",message:"\u00dcr\u00fcn katalo\u011fu do\u011frulanamad\u0131. Yeniden deneyin."},503);
      const storefrontData=await storefrontResponse.json();
      const knownProducts=new Map((storefrontData.catalogAuthoritative?[]:[...okyEdtPublicFallback(ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CATALOG),...SEAFOOD_B2B_QUOTE_CATALOG]).map(x=>[String(x.id),x]));
      for(const product of storefrontData.products||[]){knownProducts.set(String(product.id),product);if(product.source_product_id)knownProducts.set(String(product.source_product_id),product);}
      // Validate only submitted IDs, including products beyond the first catalogue page.
      const quoteDB=env&&(env.COMMERCE_DB||env.ADMIN_DB||env.DB||env['Veritaban\u0131']||env['Veritabani']||env['Veritaban\u01311']);
      if(storefrontData.catalogAuthoritative&&quoteDB){
        const requestedIds=JSON.stringify(products.map(x=>String(x&&x.id||'')));
        try{
          const tableNames=new Set(((await quoteDB.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('oky_product_commerce_v1','oky_product_meta_v1','oky_brands_v1')").all()).results||[]).map(x=>x.name));
          const cols=new Set(((await quoteDB.prepare('PRAGMA table_info(b2b_products_v1)').all()).results||[]).map(x=>x.name));
          const sourceMatch=cols.has('source_product_id')?' OR source_product_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))':'';
          const query=quoteDB.prepare('SELECT * FROM b2b_products_v1 WHERE id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))'+sourceMatch);
          const rows=(await query.bind(...(sourceMatch?[requestedIds,requestedIds]:[requestedIds])).all()).results||[];
          const rowIds=JSON.stringify(rows.map(x=>String(x.id)));
          const commerce=tableNames.has('oky_product_commerce_v1')?((await quoteDB.prepare('SELECT * FROM oky_product_commerce_v1 WHERE product_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))').bind(rowIds).all()).results||[]):[];
          const meta=tableNames.has('oky_product_meta_v1')?((await quoteDB.prepare('SELECT * FROM oky_product_meta_v1 WHERE product_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))').bind(rowIds).all()).results||[]):[];
          const brands=tableNames.has('oky_brands_v1')&&meta.length?((await quoteDB.prepare('SELECT id,name FROM oky_brands_v1 WHERE id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))').bind(JSON.stringify(meta.map(x=>x.brand_id).filter(Boolean))).all()).results||[]):[];
          for(const item of products)knownProducts.delete(String(item&&item.id||''));
          for(const row of rows){
            const m=meta.find(x=>String(x.product_id)===String(row.id))||{},c=commerce.find(x=>String(x.product_id)===String(row.id))||{},brand=brands.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(m.brand_id));
            const canonical={...row,...m,...c,id:String(row.id),name:String(row.name),image:row.image_url||'',brand:brand?.name||row.brand||''};
            if(Number(row.active)!==1||!String(row.image_url||'').trim()||retiredSupplierProduct(canonical))continue;
            knownProducts.set(String(row.id),canonical);if(row.source_product_id)knownProducts.set(String(row.source_product_id),canonical);
          }
        }catch(_){return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE',message:'Ürün kataloğu doğrulanamadı. Yeniden deneyin.'},503)}
      }
      const seen=new Set();
      for(const item of products){const id=String(item&&item.id||'');if(!knownProducts.has(id))return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"INVALID_PRODUCTS",productId:id,message:"Sepetteki \u00fcr\u00fcn art\u0131k katalogda bulunmuyor. Sepetinizi kontrol edin."},400);const canonical=knownProducts.get(id),canonicalId=String(canonical.id);if(seen.has(canonicalId))return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"DUPLICATE_PRODUCT",productId:id},400);seen.add(canonicalId);if(okyR44ProductUnavailable(canonical))return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE",productId:id,message:"Sepette stokta olmayan \u00fcr\u00fcn var."},400);}

      const allowedUnits=new Set(["Adet","Paket","Koli","Kg","Gram","Litre","Teneke","Kova","Kutu","\u015ei\u015fe","Kasa"]);
      const safeProducts=products.map(x=>{const canonical=knownProducts.get(String(x.id)),quantity=Number(x.quantity),unit=String(x.unit||"").trim();return{id:String(canonical.id),name:String(canonical.name).slice(0,180),quantity:Number.isFinite(quantity)&&quantity>0&&quantity<=100000?Math.round(quantity*1000)/1000:null,unit:allowedUnits.has(unit)?unit:null}});
      if(!safeProducts.length)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"INVALID_PRODUCTS",message:"Ge\u00e7erli \u00fcr\u00fcn bulunamad\u0131."},400);
      if(safeProducts.some(x=>x.quantity===null||!Number.isFinite(x.quantity)||x.quantity<=0||x.unit===null))return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"INVALID_QUANTITY_UNIT",message:"Her \u00fcr\u00fcn i\u00e7in ge\u00e7erli miktar ve birim se\u00e7ilmelidir."},400);

      for(const x of products){const p=knownProducts.get(String(x.id)),n=Number(x.quantity),minimum=Number(p.min_order_qty||.001),step=Number(p.qty_step||.001);if(!Number.isFinite(n)||n<minimum-1e-8||!Number.isFinite(step)||step<=0||Math.abs((n-minimum)/step-Math.round((n-minimum)/step))>1e-6||(p.unit&&allowedUnits.has(p.unit)&&x.unit!==p.unit))return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'INVALID_QUANTITY_UNIT',productId:String(x.id),message:'\u00dcr\u00fcn miktar\u0131n\u0131, minimumunu ve birimini kontrol edin.'},400);}
      // cart-idempotency-v1: stable inquiry primary key avoids non-atomic reservation state.
      const idem=String(body.idempotencyKey||request.headers.get('Idempotency-Key')||'').trim();
      if(idem&&!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{16,100}$/.test(idem))return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY'},400);
      const member=await memberSession(request,env);if(!member)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'UNAUTHENTICATED'},401);
      const idemHash=idem?await memberSHA(JSON.stringify([member.user_id,member.business_id,idem])):'';
      const quoteNo=idemHash?'OKY-'+idemHash.slice(0,16).toUpperCase():`OKY-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,"")}-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0,8).toUpperCase()}`;
      const payload = {source:"OKYANUS_EDT_V2",quoteNo,customer:{name:name.slice(0,120),business:business.slice(0,160),phone:phone.slice(0,30),email:email.slice(0,160)},products:safeProducts,consent:{kvkk:true,textVersion:String(body&&body.consent&&body.consent.textVersion||"2026-09-08-v1").slice(0,40),purpose:"QUOTE_REQUEST",acceptedAt:new Date().toISOString()},createdAt:new Date().toISOString()};
      const quoteMessage='Talep No: '+quoteNo+'\n\nSe\u00e7ilen \u00fcr\u00fcnler ve miktarlar:\n'+safeProducts.map((p,i)=>`${i+1}. ${p.name} \u2014 ${p.quantity} ${p.unit} [${p.id}]`).join('\n')+(body.note?'\n\nM\u00fc\u015fteri notu: '+String(body.note).slice(0,1000):'');
      const savedResponse=await okyContactMessageAPI(new Request(request.url,{method:'POST',headers:request.headers,body:JSON.stringify({name,business,phone,email,subject:'Teklif talebi \u00b7 '+quoteNo,message:quoteMessage,consent:true,__quoteInquiryId:idemHash?'quote-v1-'+idemHash:'',__quoteNo:quoteNo})}),env);
      const savedResult=await savedResponse.json();
      if(!savedResponse.ok||!savedResult.ok)return responseJSON(savedResult,savedResponse.status);
      return responseJSON({ok:true,quoteNo,id:savedResult.id,message:'Teklif talebiniz kaydedildi.',delivery:'D1_SAVED',notification:savedResult.notification,duplicate:!!savedResult.duplicate,status:'NEW'},savedResult.duplicate?200:201);
    }

    async function quoteAPI(request, env) {

      let body;

      const contentType=String(request.headers.get("content-type")||"").toLowerCase();
      const contentLength=Number(request.headers.get("content-length")||0);
      if(!contentType.includes("application/json"))return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE",message:"Teklif verisi JSON bi\u00e7iminde g\u00f6nderilmelidir."},415);
      if(contentLength>100000)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE",message:"Teklif verisi izin verilen boyutu a\u015f\u0131yor."},413);

      try {
        body = await request.json();
      } catch {
        return responseJSON(
          {
            ok: false,
            error: "INVALID_JSON",
            message: "Teklif verisi okunamad\u0131."
          },
          400
        );
      }

      const customer = body && body.customer ? body.customer : {name:[body&&body.firstName,body&&body.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(" "),business:body&&body.businessName,phone:body&&body.phone,email:body&&body.email};

      const products =
        body && Array.isArray(body.products)
          ? body.products
          : [];
      if (!products.length) return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"EMPTY_QUOTE",message:"Teklif listesinde \u00fcr\u00fcn bulunmuyor."},400);

      const name =
        String(customer.name || "").trim();

      const business =
        String(customer.business || "").trim();

      const phone =
        String(customer.phone || "").trim();

      const email =
        String(customer.email || "").trim();

      if (
        !name ||
        !business ||
        !phone ||
        !email
      ) {
        return responseJSON(
          {
            ok: false,
            error: "MISSING_FIELDS",
            message: "Zorunlu bilgiler eksik."
          },
          400
        );
      }

      const consentOk=body&&((body.consent&&body.consent.kvkk===true)||body.kvkkAcknowledged===true);
      if(!consentOk)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"KVKK_ACK_REQUIRED",message:"KVKK Ayd\u0131nlatma Metni bilgilendirmesi onaylanmal\u0131d\u0131r."},400);
      const phoneDigits=phone.replace(/\D/g,"");
      if(name.length<3||name.length>120||business.length<2||business.length>160||phone.length>30||email.length>160)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"INVALID_FIELDS",message:"Ad, i\u015fletme ve ileti\u015fim alanlar\u0131n\u0131n uzunluklar\u0131n\u0131 kontrol edin."},400);
      if(!/^\+?[0-9 ()-]+$/.test(phone)||phoneDigits.length<10||phoneDigits.length>15)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"INVALID_PHONE",message:"Ge\u00e7erli bir telefon numaras\u0131 girin."},400);
      if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(email))return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"INVALID_EMAIL",message:"Ge\u00e7erli bir e-posta adresi girin."},400);
      if(products.length>100)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"TOO_MANY_PRODUCTS",message:"Tek seferde en fazla 100 \u00fcr\u00fcn g\u00f6nderilebilir."},400);
      const knownProducts=new Map([...okyEdtPublicFallback(ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CATALOG),...SEAFOOD_B2B_QUOTE_CATALOG].map(x=>[String(x.id),x]));
      const allowedUnits=new Set(["Adet","Paket","Koli","Kg","Gram","Litre","Teneke","Kova","Kutu","\u015ei\u015fe","Kasa"]);
      const safeProducts=products.filter(x=>x&&knownProducts.has(String(x.id||""))).slice(0,100).map(x=>{const canonical=knownProducts.get(String(x.id)),quantity=Number(x.quantity),unit=String(x.unit||"").trim();return{id:String(canonical.id),name:String(canonical.name).slice(0,180),quantity:Number.isFinite(quantity)&&quantity>0&&quantity<=100000?Math.round(quantity*100)/100:null,unit:allowedUnits.has(unit)?unit:null}});
      if(!safeProducts.length)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"INVALID_PRODUCTS",message:"Ge\u00e7erli \u00fcr\u00fcn bulunamad\u0131."},400);
      if(safeProducts.some(x=>x.quantity===null||!Number.isFinite(x.quantity)||x.quantity<=0||x.unit===null))return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"INVALID_QUANTITY_UNIT",message:"Her \u00fcr\u00fcn i\u00e7in ge\u00e7erli miktar ve birim se\u00e7ilmelidir."},400);

      const quoteNo=`OKY-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,"")}-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0,8).toUpperCase()}`;
      const payload = {source:"OKYANUS_EDT_V2",quoteNo,customer:{name:name.slice(0,120),business:business.slice(0,160),phone:phone.slice(0,30),email:email.slice(0,160)},products:safeProducts,consent:{kvkk:true,textVersion:String(body&&body.consent&&body.consent.textVersion||"2026-09-08-v1").slice(0,40),purpose:"QUOTE_REQUEST",acceptedAt:new Date().toISOString()},createdAt:new Date().toISOString()};
      const quoteMessage='Talep No: '+quoteNo+'\n\nSe\u00e7ilen \u00fcr\u00fcnler ve miktarlar:\n'+safeProducts.map((p,i)=>`${i+1}. ${p.name} \u2014 ${p.quantity} ${p.unit} [${p.id}]`).join('\n')+(body.note?'\n\nM\u00fc\u015fteri notu: '+String(body.note).slice(0,1000):'');
      const savedResponse=await okyContactMessageAPI(new Request(request.url,{method:'POST',headers:request.headers,body:JSON.stringify({name,business,phone,email,subject:'Teklif talebi \u00b7 '+quoteNo,message:quoteMessage,consent:true})}),env);
      const savedResult=await savedResponse.json();
      if(!savedResponse.ok||!savedResult.ok)return responseJSON(savedResult,savedResponse.status);
      return responseJSON({ok:true,quoteNo,id:savedResult.id,message:'Teklif talebiniz kaydedildi.',delivery:'D1_SAVED',notification:savedResult.notification},201);
    }

    async function costPersistenceAPI(request, env) {
      if (!env || !env.DB) {
        return responseJSON({
          ok: false,
          error: "D1_NOT_BOUND",
          message: "COST D1 ba\u011flant\u0131s\u0131 bulunamad\u0131; mevcut cihaz kay\u0131tlar\u0131 korunuyor."
        }, 503);
      }

      const db = env.DB;

      if (request.method === "GET") {
        const r = await db.prepare(
          "SELECT id, record_type, title, payload, created_at, updated_at FROM cost_records ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 500"
        ).all();

        return responseJSON({
          ok: true,
          records: r.results || []
        });
      }

      if (request.method === "POST") {
        let body;

        try {
          body = await request.json();
        } catch {
          return responseJSON({
            ok: false,
            error: "INVALID_JSON"
          }, 400);
        }

        const id = crypto.randomUUID();
        const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();
        const recordType = body?.record_type || "cost";
        const title = body?.title || "COST Kayd\u0131";

        await db.prepare(
          "INSERT INTO cost_records (id, record_type, title, payload, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)"
        )
        .bind(
          id,
          recordType,
          title,
          JSON.stringify(body || {}),
          createdAt,
          createdAt
        )
        .run();

        return responseJSON({
          ok: true,
          id,
          createdAt
        }, 201);
      }

      return responseJSON({
        ok: false,
        error: "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED"
      }, 405);
    }

    function materialCard(x){const r=usageResearch[x.id];const extra=r?line("Kullan\u0131m amac\u0131",r.purpose)+line("Neye yak\u0131\u015f\u0131r",r.pairs)+line("Nerelerde kullan\u0131l\u0131r",r.applications)+line("Nas\u0131l kullan\u0131l\u0131r",r.technique):"";return '<h2>'+esc(x.name)+'</h2>'+line("\u0130ngilizce ad\u0131",x.english)+line("Kullan\u0131lan b\u00f6l\u00fcm",x.part)+line("Form",x.forms)+line("Aroma",x.aroma)+line("G\u00fc\u00e7",x.power?x.power+"/5":A)+extra+'<button class="close">Kapat</button>'}
    function blendCard(x){const f=verified500[x.name];const formula=f?'<div class="line"><b>500 g referans form\u00fcl</b><span>'+f.map(i=>esc(i[0])+": "+i[1].toFixed(2).replace(".00","")+" g").join("<br>")+'</span></div>':'<div class="line"><b>500 g form\u00fcl</b><span class="research">FORM\u00dcL VER\u0130S\u0130 EKS\u0130K</span></div>';return '<h2>'+esc(x.name)+'</h2>'+line("Bile\u015fenler",x.ingredients)+formula+line("Kullan\u0131m",blendUsage[x.name]||x.usage)+line("Alerjen",blendAllergen[x.name]||"Re\u00e7eteye g\u00f6re kontrol")+'<button class="close">Kapat</button>'}
    function render(mode){
     detail.className="detail";detail.innerHTML="";tabs.forEach(t=>t.classList.toggle("on",t.dataset.mode===mode));
     const list=[...(mode==="blend"?blends:materials)].sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name,"tr-TR",{usage:"sort",sensitivity:"base"}));count.textContent=list.length+" kay\u0131t";
     grid.className=mode==="blend"?"grid blends":"grid";grid.innerHTML=list.map(x=>'<button class="item" data-id="'+esc(x.id)+'">'+esc(x.name)+'</button>').join("");
     grid.querySelectorAll(".item").forEach(btn=>btn.onclick=()=>{
       grid.querySelectorAll(".item").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("on"));btn.classList.add("on");
       const x=list.find(v=>v.id===btn.dataset.id);detail.innerHTML=mode==="blend"?blendCard(x):materialCard(x);detail.className="detail show";
       detail.querySelector(".close").onclick=()=>{detail.className="detail";btn.classList.remove("on")};
       detail.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"nearest"});
     });
    }
    tabs.forEach(t=>t.onclick=()=>render(t.dataset.mode));render("all");

    const digitalMenuSchemaSetupCache=new WeakMap();
    async function digitalMenuEnsureSchema(env){
      if(!env || !env.DB) return false;
      const cached=digitalMenuSchemaSetupCache.get(env.DB);if(cached)return await cached;
      const setup=(async()=>{
      await memberD1Run(env.DB.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS digital_menus (
        menu_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        edit_token TEXT NOT NULL,
        business_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        menu_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        description TEXT DEFAULT '',
        theme TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'classic',
        payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )`));
      await memberD1Run(env.DB.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_digital_menus_status ON digital_menus(status)`));
      let columns=await memberD1All(env.DB.prepare('PRAGMA table_info(digital_menus)'));
      for(const name of ['business_id','user_id']){if(!(columns.results||[]).some(c=>c.name===name)){try{await memberD1Run(env.DB.prepare('ALTER TABLE digital_menus ADD COLUMN '+name+' TEXT'))}catch(error){const current=await memberD1All(env.DB.prepare('PRAGMA table_info(digital_menus)'));if(!(current.results||[]).some(c=>c.name===name))throw error}}}
      await memberD1Run(env.DB.prepare('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_digital_menus_owner_status ON digital_menus(business_id,status)'));
      return true;
      })();digitalMenuSchemaSetupCache.set(env.DB,setup);try{return await setup}catch(error){if(digitalMenuSchemaSetupCache.get(env.DB)===setup)digitalMenuSchemaSetupCache.delete(env.DB);throw error}
    }

    function digitalMenuId(){
      const a=new Uint8Array(8); crypto.getRandomValues(a);
      return "MN-"+Array.from(a,b=>b.toString(36).padStart(2,"0")).join("").toUpperCase().slice(0,12);
    }
    function digitalMenuToken(){
      const a=new Uint8Array(24); crypto.getRandomValues(a);
      return Array.from(a,b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
    }
    function digitalMenuSafeItemId(v){return String(v||"").trim().replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g,"-").replace(/-+/g,"-").slice(0,50)||"item"}
    function digitalMenuDecodeImage(v){
      const raw=String(v||"");if(!raw)return null;if(raw.length>240000)return{error:"IMAGE_DATA_TOO_LARGE"};
      const m=raw.match(/^data:image\/(jpeg|png|webp);base64,([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)$/);if(!m)return{error:"INVALID_IMAGE_DATA"};
      let binary="";try{binary=atob(m[2])}catch(e){return{error:"INVALID_IMAGE_DATA"}}if(!binary.length||binary.length>180000)return{error:"IMAGE_BINARY_TOO_LARGE"};
      const bytes=new Uint8Array(binary.length);for(let i=0;i<binary.length;i++)bytes[i]=binary.charCodeAt(i);const mime=photoDetectedMime(bytes);
      if(!mime||mime!=="image/"+m[1])return{error:"INVALID_IMAGE_SIGNATURE"};return{bytes,mime};
    }
    function digitalMenuCleanPayload(v){
      const s=x=>String(x??"").trim();
      const cats=Array.isArray(v.categories)?v.categories.slice(0,20).map(c=>({id:s(c.id).slice(0,50),name:s(c.name).slice(0,80)})).filter(c=>c.name):[];
      const catIds=new Set(cats.map(c=>c.id));
      const items=Array.isArray(v.items)?v.items.slice(0,100).map(i=>({
        id:s(i.id).slice(0,50), categoryId:s(i.categoryId).slice(0,50),
        name:s(i.name).slice(0,120), description:s(i.description).slice(0,360),
        price:Math.max(0,Number(i.price)||0), imageData:s(i.image).slice(0,240001), imageRef:s(i.imageRef).slice(0,180)
      })).filter(i=>i.name && catIds.has(i.categoryId)):[];
      return {
        businessName:s(v.businessName).slice(0,120),
        menuName:s(v.menuName).slice(0,120),
        description:s(v.description).slice(0,500),
        logo:(/^data:image\/(png|jpeg|webp);base64,/.test(s(v.logo)) && s(v.logo).length<=500000)?s(v.logo):"",
        theme:["classic","modern","premium","cafe","bistro","street","mediterranean","minimal"].includes(s(v.theme))?s(v.theme):"classic",
        categories:cats, items
      };
    }

    async function digitalMenuAPI(request, env, url){
      if(!env || !env.DB) return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"D1_REQUIRED",message:"Dijital Men\u00fc yay\u0131nlama i\u00e7in D1 ba\u011flant\u0131s\u0131 gereklidir."},503);
      if(!memberPortalEnabled(env))return memberJSON({ok:false,error:"MEMBER_PORTAL_DISABLED"},503);
      if(!request.headers.get('origin')||!memberSameOrigin(request))return memberJSON({ok:false,error:"ORIGIN_REJECTED"},403);
      const me=await memberSession(request,env);if(!me)return memberJSON({ok:false,error:"UNAUTHENTICATED"},401);const expectedBusiness=request.headers.get("x-okyanus-business");if(!expectedBusiness)return memberJSON({ok:false,error:"BUSINESS_SCOPE_REQUIRED",message:"\u0130\u015fletme sayfas\u0131n\u0131 yeniden a\u00e7\u0131n."},400);if(expectedBusiness&&expectedBusiness!==me.business_id)return memberJSON({ok:false,error:"BUSINESS_SESSION_CHANGED",message:"\u0130\u015fletme oturumu de\u011fi\u015fti. Bu sayfay\u0131 yeniden a\u00e7\u0131n."},409);
      if(!['owner','admin','editor'].includes(String(me.role||'').toLowerCase()))return memberJSON({ok:false,error:"FORBIDDEN"},403);
      await digitalMenuEnsureSchema(env);
      const readMenuBody=async()=>{
        const limit=25000000,declared=Number(request.headers.get("content-length")||0);if(declared>limit){if(request.body)try{await request.body.cancel()}catch(_){}return{error:"PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE",status:413}}
        const chunks=[];let length=0,reader=null;
        try{if(request.body){reader=request.body.getReader();for(;;){const part=await reader.read();if(part.done)break;length+=part.value.byteLength;if(length>limit){try{await reader.cancel()}catch(_){}return{error:"PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE",status:413}}chunks.push(part.value)}}}catch(_){return{error:"INVALID_JSON",status:400}}finally{if(reader)try{reader.releaseLock()}catch(_){}}
        let body;try{const bytes=new Uint8Array(length);let offset=0;for(const chunk of chunks){bytes.set(chunk,offset);offset+=chunk.byteLength}body=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));if(!body||typeof body!=="object"||Array.isArray(body))return{error:"INVALID_JSON",status:400}}catch(_){return{error:"INVALID_JSON",status:400}}
        if(body.categories!==undefined&&(!Array.isArray(body.categories)||body.categories.length>20||body.categories.some(c=>!c||typeof c!=="object"||Array.isArray(c))))return{error:"INVALID_CATEGORIES",status:400};
        if(body.items!==undefined&&(!Array.isArray(body.items)||body.items.length>100||body.items.some(i=>!i||typeof i!=="object"||Array.isArray(i)||!Number.isFinite(Number(i.price??0))||Number(i.price??0)<0)))return{error:"INVALID_ITEMS",status:400};
        if(body.logo){const logo=String(body.logo);if(logo.length>500000)return{error:"IMAGE_DATA_TOO_LARGE",status:413};const image=logo.match(/^data:image\/(jpeg|png|webp);base64,([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)$/);if(!image)return{error:"INVALID_LOGO_IMAGE",status:400};try{const binary=atob(image[2]),bytes=new Uint8Array(binary.length);for(let i=0;i<binary.length;i++)bytes[i]=binary.charCodeAt(i);if(photoDetectedMime(bytes)!=="image/"+image[1])return{error:"INVALID_LOGO_IMAGE",status:400}}catch(_){return{error:"INVALID_LOGO_IMAGE",status:400}}}
        return{body};
      };
      if(request.method==="POST" && url.pathname==="/api/digital-menu/publish"){
        const parsed=await readMenuBody();if(parsed.error)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:parsed.error},parsed.status);const body=parsed.body;
        const data=digitalMenuCleanPayload(body);
        if(!data.businessName || !data.menuName) return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"REQUIRED_FIELDS",message:"\u0130\u015fletme ad\u0131 ve men\u00fc ad\u0131 zorunludur."},400);
        if(!data.categories.length) return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"CATEGORY_REQUIRED",message:"En az bir kategori olu\u015fturun."},400);
        if(!data.items.length) return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"ITEM_REQUIRED",message:"En az bir \u00fcr\u00fcn ekleyin."},400);
        const now=new Date().toISOString(), menuId=digitalMenuId(), token=digitalMenuToken();
        const assetResult=await digitalMenuStoreAssets(data,menuId,env['FOTO\u011eRAF_TEMP']);
        if(assetResult.error)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:assetResult.error,message:assetResult.message},assetResult.error==="MENU_ASSET_STORE_REQUIRED"||assetResult.error==="MENU_ASSET_WRITE_FAILED"?503:413);
        try{await memberD1Run(env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO digital_menus(menu_id,edit_token,business_name,menu_name,description,theme,payload_json,status,created_at,updated_at,business_id,user_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`)
          .bind(menuId,token,data.businessName,data.menuName,data.description,data.theme,JSON.stringify(data),"active",now,now,me.business_id,me.user_id));}catch(e){await digitalMenuCleanupNewAssets(env['FOTO\u011eRAF_TEMP'],assetResult.createdKeys);return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"MENU_SAVE_FAILED",message:"Men\u00fc kaydedilemedi. Tekrar deneyin."},503)}
        return responseJSON({ok:true,menuId,editToken:token,url:new URL("/menu/"+encodeURIComponent(menuId),url.origin).toString()});
      }
      if(request.method==="POST" && url.pathname==="/api/digital-menu/update"){
        const parsed=await readMenuBody();if(parsed.error)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:parsed.error},parsed.status);const body=parsed.body;
        const menuId=String(body.menuId||""), token=String(body.editToken||""), data=digitalMenuCleanPayload(body);
        // Only the original secret edit token can migrate an ownerless legacy menu.
        await memberD1Run(env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE digital_menus SET business_id=?,user_id=? WHERE menu_id=? AND edit_token=? AND business_id IS NULL AND status='active'`).bind(me.business_id,me.user_id,menuId,token));
        const row=await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT menu_id FROM digital_menus WHERE menu_id=? AND edit_token=? AND business_id=? AND status='active'`).bind(menuId,token,me.business_id).first();
        if(!row) return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"NOT_AUTHORIZED",message:"Bu men\u00fcy\u00fc d\u00fczenleme yetkisi bulunamad\u0131."},403);
        if(!data.businessName || !data.menuName || !data.categories.length || !data.items.length) return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"INCOMPLETE_MENU",message:"Men\u00fc bilgileri, kategori ve \u00fcr\u00fcnleri kontrol edin."},400);

        let previous=/** @type {Record<string,any>} */ ({});try{previous=JSON.parse(previousRow&&previousRow.payload_json||"{}")}catch(e){}
        const assetResult=await digitalMenuStoreAssets(data,menuId,env['FOTO\u011eRAF_TEMP'],previous);
        if(assetResult.error)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:assetResult.error,message:assetResult.message},assetResult.error==="MENU_ASSET_STORE_REQUIRED"||assetResult.error==="MENU_ASSET_WRITE_FAILED"?503:413);

          .bind(data.businessName,data.menuName,data.description,data.theme,JSON.stringify(data),new Date().toISOString(),menuId,token,me.business_id));if(!commit.meta||!commit.meta.changes){await digitalMenuCleanupNewAssets(env['FOTO\u011eRAF_TEMP'],assetResult.createdKeys);return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"MENU_UPDATE_CONFLICT",message:"Men\u00fc g\u00fcncellenemedi. Sayfay\u0131 yenileyip tekrar deneyin."},409)}}catch(e){await digitalMenuCleanupNewAssets(env['FOTO\u011eRAF_TEMP'],assetResult.createdKeys);return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"MENU_SAVE_FAILED",message:"Men\u00fc g\u00fcncellenemedi. Canl\u0131 men\u00fcn\u00fcz korunmu\u015ftur."},503)}
        const currentRefs=new Set(data.items.map(i=>i.imageRef).filter(Boolean));
        // Prior immutable assets are retained; concurrent updates may still reference them.
        return responseJSON({ok:true,menuId,url:new URL("/menu/"+encodeURIComponent(menuId),url.origin).toString()});
      }
      if(request.method==="POST" && url.pathname==="/api/digital-menu/delete"){
        const parsed=await readMenuBody();if(parsed.error)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:parsed.error},parsed.status);const body=parsed.body;
        const menuId=String(body.menuId||""),token=String(body.editToken||"");
        // Only the original secret edit token can migrate an ownerless legacy menu.
        await memberD1Run(env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE digital_menus SET business_id=?,user_id=? WHERE menu_id=? AND edit_token=? AND business_id IS NULL AND status='active'`).bind(me.business_id,me.user_id,menuId,token));
        const row=await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT menu_id FROM digital_menus WHERE menu_id=? AND edit_token=? AND business_id=? AND status='active'`).bind(menuId,token,me.business_id).first();
        if(!row)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"NOT_AUTHORIZED"},403);

    async function publicDigitalMenuAsset(menuId,itemId,env){
      const store=env&&env['FOTO\u011eRAF_TEMP'],safeItem=digitalMenuSafeItemId(itemId);if(!store||!env||!env.DB||!/^MN-[A-Z0-9]+$/.test(String(menuId||""))||safeItem!==String(itemId||""))return new Response("Not found",{status:404});
      const row=await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT payload_json FROM digital_menus WHERE menu_id=? AND status='active'`).bind(menuId).first();let payload=/** @type {Record<string,any>} */ ({});try{payload=JSON.parse(row&&row.payload_json||"{}")}catch(e){}const key="menu-assets/v1/"+menuId+"/"+safeItem;
      if(!row||!Array.isArray(payload.items)||!payload.items.some(i=>i&&i.imageRef===key))return new Response("Not found",{status:404});
      const found=await store.getWithMetadata(key,{type:"arrayBuffer"});if(!found||!found.value)return new Response("Not found",{status:404});
      const detected=photoDetectedMime(new Uint8Array(found.value));if(!detected)return new Response("Not found",{status:404});
      return new Response(found.value,{headers:{"content-type":detected,"cache-control":"public, max-age=86400","x-content-type-options":"nosniff"}});
    }

    async function digitalMenuStoreAssets(data,menuId,store,previous={}){
      const operation=crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g,""),prepared=[],priorRefs=new Set((previous.items||[]).map(i=>i.imageRef).filter(Boolean));
      // Validate every image before writing anything; content hashes keep live assets immutable.
      for(const item of data.items){
        if(!item.imageData){
          const ref=String(item.imageRef||"");
          if(ref&&(!ref.startsWith("menu-assets/v1/"+menuId+"/")||!priorRefs.has(ref)))return{error:"INVALID_IMAGE_REFERENCE",message:"\u00dcr\u00fcn g\u00f6rseli bu men\u00fcye ait de\u011fil."};
          delete item.imageData;continue
        }
        if(!store)return{error:"MENU_ASSET_STORE_REQUIRED",message:"\u00dcr\u00fcn g\u00f6rselleri i\u00e7in medya deposu kullan\u0131lam\u0131yor."};
        const decoded=digitalMenuDecodeImage(item.imageData);
        if(!decoded||decoded.error)return{error:decoded&&decoded.error||"INVALID_IMAGE_DATA",message:"Bir \u00fcr\u00fcn g\u00f6rseli g\u00fcvenli boyut veya dosya do\u011frulamas\u0131ndan ge\u00e7emedi."};
        const key="menu-assets/v1/"+menuId+"/img-"+(await photoSha256(decoded.bytes)).slice(0,20)+"-"+operation.slice(0,24);
        prepared.push({item,decoded,key});
      }
      const createdKeys=[];
      try{
        for(const entry of prepared){
          if(!createdKeys.includes(entry.key)){
            await store.put(entry.key,entry.decoded.bytes,{metadata:{contentType:entry.decoded.mime}});
            createdKeys.push(entry.key);
          }
          entry.item.imageRef=entry.key;delete entry.item.imageData;
        }
      }catch(e){await digitalMenuCleanupNewAssets(store,createdKeys);return{error:"MENU_ASSET_WRITE_FAILED",message:"\u00dcr\u00fcn g\u00f6rselleri kaydedilemedi. Canl\u0131 men\u00fcn\u00fcz korunmu\u015ftur."}}
      return{ok:true,createdKeys};
    }
    async function digitalMenuCleanupNewAssets(store,keys){
      if(!store)return;await Promise.allSettled((keys||[]).map(key=>store.delete(key)));
    }

    async function digitalMenuDeleteAssets(payload,store,menuId=""){
    if(!store)return;
    const keys=new Set((payload&&Array.isArray(payload.items)?payload.items:[]).map(i=>String(i&&i.imageRef||"")).filter(k=>k.startsWith("menu-assets/v1/")));
    if(/^MN-[A-Z0-9]+$/.test(menuId)&&typeof store.list==="function"){let cursor="";do{const found=await store.list({prefix:"menu-assets/v1/"+menuId+"/",...(cursor?{cursor}:{})});for(const key of found.keys||[])keys.add(key.name);const next=found.list_complete?"":String(found.cursor||"");if(next&&next===cursor)throw new Error("MENU_CLEANUP_CURSOR");cursor=next}while(cursor)}
    const results=await Promise.allSettled([...keys].map(key=>store.delete(key)));if(results.some(result=>result.status==="rejected"))throw new Error("MENU_ASSET_CLEANUP_FAILED");
    }

    function photoDetectedMime(bytes){
    if(!(bytes instanceof Uint8Array)||bytes.length<32)return'';
    if(bytes[0]===255&&bytes[1]===216){let offset=2,dimensions=false;while(offset+3<bytes.length){if(bytes[offset++]!==255)return'';while(bytes[offset]===255)offset++;const marker=bytes[offset++];if(marker===217)return'';if(marker===1||marker>=208&&marker<=215)continue;if(offset+2>bytes.length)return'';const size=bytes[offset]*256+bytes[offset+1];if(size<2||offset+size>bytes.length)return'';if([192,193,194,195,197,198,199,201,202,203,205,206,207].includes(marker)){if(size<8)return'';dimensions=(bytes[offset+3]*256+bytes[offset+4])>0&&(bytes[offset+5]*256+bytes[offset+6])>0;if(!dimensions)return''}if(marker===218){if(!dimensions)return'';for(let i=bytes.length-2;i>=Math.max(offset+size,bytes.length-65536);i--)if(bytes[i]===255&&bytes[i+1]===217)return'image/jpeg';return''}offset+=size}return''}
    if(bytes.length>=45&&[137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10].every((v,i)=>bytes[i]===v)&&String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(12,16))==='IHDR'&&bytes[8]===0&&bytes[9]===0&&bytes[10]===0&&bytes[11]===13&&String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(-8,-4))==='IEND'){const view=new DataView(bytes.buffer,bytes.byteOffset,bytes.byteLength);return view.getUint32(16)>0&&view.getUint32(20)>0?'image/png':''}
    if(String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(0,4))==='RIFF'&&String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(8,12))==='WEBP'){const size=(bytes[4]|bytes[5]<<8|bytes[6]<<16|bytes[7]<<24)>>>0;if(size+8!==bytes.length)return'';const type=String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(12,16));if(type==='VP8 '&&bytes[23]===157&&bytes[24]===1&&bytes[25]===42&&((bytes[26]|bytes[27]<<8)&16383)>0&&((bytes[28]|bytes[29]<<8)&16383)>0)return'image/webp';if(type==='VP8L'&&bytes[20]===47)return'image/webp';if(type==='VP8X'&&bytes.length>30)return'image/webp'}return''
    }

    async function photoSha256(buffer){return [...new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',buffer))].map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')}
    // Notification state contains only a reference; customer data remains in photo_inquiries.
    async function photoNotificationSchema(DB){
      await DB.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS photo_notification_jobs_v1(
        inquiry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
        attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, next_attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
        lease_until TEXT, sent_at TEXT, last_error TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))`).run();
    }
    async function photoNotificationDispatch(env,limit=10){
      const DB=env&&env.ADMIN_DB;if(!DB)return;
      await photoNotificationSchema(DB);
      const jobs=(await DB.prepare(`SELECT inquiry_id FROM photo_notification_jobs_v1
        WHERE ((state='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=datetime('now'))
          OR (state='SENDING' AND lease_until<datetime('now')))
        AND attempts<12 ORDER BY created_at LIMIT ?`).bind(limit).all()).results||[];
      for(const job of jobs){
        const claimed=await DB.prepare(`UPDATE photo_notification_jobs_v1
          SET state='SENDING',lease_until=datetime('now','+3 minutes'),attempts=attempts+1
          WHERE inquiry_id=? AND ((state='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=datetime('now'))
          OR (state='SENDING' AND lease_until<datetime('now'))) AND attempts<12`)
          .bind(job.inquiry_id).run();
        if(Number(claimed?.meta?.changes||0)!==1)continue;
        try{
          if(!env.EMAIL||typeof env.EMAIL.send!=='function')throw new Error('EMAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED');
          const row=await DB.prepare(`SELECT request_no,business_name,contact_name,phone,media_mime,media_size
            FROM photo_inquiries WHERE id=? LIMIT 1`).bind(job.inquiry_id).first();
          if(!row)throw new Error('PHOTO_INQUIRY_MISSING');
          const cfg=mailConfig(env);
          await sendBoundEmail(env,{replyTo:cfg.from,subject:'Okyanus EDT \u00b7 Foto\u011frafl\u0131 teklif \u00b7 '+row.request_no,
            text:'Talep No: '+row.request_no+'\n\u0130\u015fletme: '+row.business_name+'\nAd Soyad: '+row.contact_name+
            '\nTelefon: '+row.phone+'\nFoto\u011fraf: '+row.media_mime+' ('+row.media_size+
            ' bayt)\nFoto\u011fraf\u0131 yetkili y\u00f6netici panelinden a\u00e7\u0131n: https://okyanus-edt-admin.hasan-kaya474.workers.dev/'});
          await DB.prepare(`UPDATE photo_notification_jobs_v1 SET state='SENT',sent_at=datetime('now'),
            lease_until=NULL,last_error=NULL WHERE inquiry_id=? AND state='SENDING'`).bind(job.inquiry_id).run();
        }catch(error){
          const reason=String(error&&error.message||'SEND_FAILED').slice(0,100);
          await DB.prepare(`UPDATE photo_notification_jobs_v1 SET
            state=CASE WHEN attempts>=12 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END,
            next_attempt_at=datetime('now','+' || min(360, 5 * (1 << min(attempts-1,6))) || ' minutes'),
            lease_until=NULL,last_error=? WHERE inquiry_id=? AND state='SENDING'`)
            .bind(reason,job.inquiry_id).run();
          console.error('PHOTO_NOTIFY_RETRY',job.inquiry_id,reason);
        }
      }
    }
    async function photoInquiryAPI(request,env){
      const DB=env&&env.ADMIN_DB,store=env&&env['FOTO\u011eRAF_TEMP'];
      if(!DB||!store)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'PHOTO_SERVICE_NOT_READY',message:'Foto\u011fraf hizmeti ge\u00e7ici olarak kullan\u0131lam\u0131yor.'},503);
      if(!request.headers.get('origin')||!memberSameOrigin(request))return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'ORIGIN_REJECTED',message:'G\u00f6nderim kayna\u011f\u0131 do\u011frulanamad\u0131.'},403);
      const length=Number(request.headers.get('content-length')||0),type=String(request.headers.get('content-type')||'').toLowerCase();
      if(length>9000000)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE',message:'Foto\u011fraf en fazla 8 MB olabilir.'},413);
      if(type.split(';',1)[0].trim()!=='multipart/form-data')return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE',message:'Form verisi ge\u00e7ersiz.'},415);
      let form;try{form=await request.formData()}catch{return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'INVALID_FORM',message:'Form okunamad\u0131.'},400)}
      const file=form.get('photo'),business=String(form.get('businessName')||'').trim(),contact=String(form.get('contactName')||'').trim(),phone=String(form.get('phone')||'').trim(),idem=String(form.get('idempotencyKey')||'').trim();
      if(!(file instanceof File)||!business||!contact||!phone||String(form.get('consent')||'')!=='on'||!idem)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'MISSING_FIELDS',message:'Zorunlu alanlar\u0131 ve KVKK onay\u0131n\u0131 tamamlay\u0131n.'},400);
      if(business.length>160||contact.length>120||phone.length>30||idem.length>100)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'FIELD_TOO_LONG',message:'Alan uzunluklar\u0131n\u0131 kontrol edin.'},400);
      const digits=phone.replace(/\D/g,'');if(!/^\+?[0-9 ()-]+$/.test(phone)||digits.length<10||digits.length>15)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'INVALID_PHONE',message:'Ge\u00e7erli bir telefon numaras\u0131 girin.'},400);
      if(file.size<4||file.size>8388608)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'INVALID_FILE_SIZE',message:'Foto\u011fraf 8 MB s\u0131n\u0131r\u0131n\u0131 a\u015f\u0131yor veya bo\u015f.'},file.size>8388608?413:400);
      const ip=String(request.headers.get('CF-Connecting-IP')||'unknown'),bucket=Math.floor(Date.now()/600000),rateKey='rate/photo/'+await photoSha256(new TextEncoder().encode(ip+'|'+bucket));let used;try{used=Number(await store.get(rateKey)||0)}catch{return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'PHOTO_RATE_STORE_FAILED',message:'Foto\u011fraf hizmeti ge\u00e7ici olarak kullan\u0131lam\u0131yor.'},503)}if(used>=8)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'RATE_LIMITED',message:'\u00c7ok fazla y\u00fckleme denemesi yap\u0131ld\u0131. On dakika sonra tekrar deneyin.'},429);try{await store.put(rateKey,String(used+1),{expirationTtl:600})}catch{return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'PHOTO_RATE_STORE_FAILED',message:'Foto\u011fraf hizmeti ge\u00e7ici olarak kullan\u0131lam\u0131yor.'},503)}
      const declaredMime=String(file.type||'').toLowerCase();
      let existing;try{existing=await DB.prepare('SELECT request_no,business_name,contact_name,phone FROM photo_inquiries WHERE idempotency_key=? LIMIT 1').bind(idem).first()}catch{return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'PHOTO_LOOKUP_FAILED',message:'Talep kay\u0131t sistemi ge\u00e7ici olarak kullan\u0131lam\u0131yor.'},503)}
      if(existing){if(existing.business_name!==business||existing.contact_name!==contact||existing.phone!==phone)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT',message:'Bu g\u00f6nderim anahtar\u0131 farkl\u0131 bilgilerle daha \u00f6nce kullan\u0131ld\u0131.'},409);return responseJSON({ok:true,requestNo:existing.request_no,duplicate:true},200)}
      const buffer=await file.arrayBuffer(),bytes=new Uint8Array(buffer),mime=photoDetectedMime(bytes);if(!mime)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'INVALID_IMAGE_SIGNATURE',message:'Dosya ge\u00e7erli bir JPEG, PNG veya WebP foto\u011fraf\u0131 de\u011fil.'},415);
      const hash=await photoSha256(buffer),id=crypto.randomUUID(),requestNo='OKY-'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,'')+'-'+id.slice(0,6).toUpperCase(),key='photo/'+id,now=new Date().toISOString(),expires=new Date(Date.now()+604800000).toISOString();
      try{await store.put(key,buffer,{expirationTtl:604800,metadata:{mime,size:file.size,sha256:hash}})}catch(err){console.error('PHOTO_TEMP_PUT_FAILED');return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'PHOTO_STORE_FAILED',message:'Foto\u011fraf ge\u00e7ici alana aktar\u0131lamad\u0131.'},503)}
      try{
        const info=(await DB.prepare('PRAGMA table_info(photo_inquiries)').all()).results||[],hasConsent=info.some(x=>x.name==='consent_at')&&info.some(x=>x.name==='consent_version'),mediaName='alis-listesi.'+(mime==='image/png'?'png':mime==='image/webp'?'webp':'jpg');
        let insertResult;
        if(hasConsent)insertResult=await DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO photo_inquiries(id,request_no,business_name,contact_name,phone,status,temp_media_key,media_name,media_mime,media_size,media_sha256,media_expires_at,idempotency_key,consent_at,consent_version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,'NEW',?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`).bind(id,requestNo,business,contact,phone,key,mediaName,mime,file.size,hash,expires,idem,now,'2026-09-14-v1',now,now).run();
        else insertResult=await DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO photo_inquiries(id,request_no,business_name,contact_name,phone,status,temp_media_key,media_name,media_mime,media_size,media_sha256,media_expires_at,idempotency_key,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,'NEW',?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`).bind(id,requestNo,business,contact,phone,key,mediaName,mime,file.size,hash,expires,idem,now,now).run();
        if(!insertResult||insertResult.success===false)throw new Error('PHOTO_D1_INSERT_UNSUCCESSFUL');
      }catch(err){try{await store.delete(key)}catch{}let row=null;try{row=await DB.prepare('SELECT request_no,business_name,contact_name,phone FROM photo_inquiries WHERE idempotency_key=? LIMIT 1').bind(idem).first()}catch{}if(row){if(row.business_name!==business||row.contact_name!==contact||row.phone!==phone)return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT',message:'Bu g\u00f6nderim anahtar\u0131 farkl\u0131 bilgilerle daha \u00f6nce kullan\u0131ld\u0131.'},409);return responseJSON({ok:true,requestNo:row.request_no,duplicate:true},200)}console.error('PHOTO_D1_INSERT_FAILED',String(err&&err.message||err).slice(0,120));return responseJSON({ok:false,error:'PHOTO_REQUEST_SAVE_FAILED',message:'Talep kaydedilemedi; foto\u011fraf sistemde tutulmad\u0131.'},503)}
      let notification='PENDING';
      try {
        await photoNotificationSchema(DB);
        await DB.prepare(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO photo_notification_jobs_v1(inquiry_id) VALUES(?)`).bind(id).run();
        await photoNotificationDispatch(env,1);
        const job=await DB.prepare(`SELECT state FROM photo_notification_jobs_v1 WHERE inquiry_id=?`).bind(id).first();
        notification=job&&job.state==='SENT'?'EMAIL_SENT':'PENDING';
      }catch(err){console.error('PHOTO_NOTIFICATION_QUEUE_FAILED',String(err&&err.message||err).slice(0,100))}
      return responseJSON({ok:true,requestNo,message:'Foto\u011frafl\u0131 teklif talebiniz al\u0131nd\u0131.',notification},201);
    }

        return {ok:true};

    }
    async function okyContactMessageAPI(request,env){
      let body=/** @type {Record<string,any>} */ ({});

      const firstName=String(body&&body.firstName||"").trim(),lastName=String(body&&body.lastName||"").trim(),legacyName=String(body&&body.name||"").trim();
      const name=(firstName||lastName)?`${firstName} ${lastName}`.trim():legacyName;
      const company=String(body&&body.business||body&&body.company||"").trim(),phone=String(body&&body.phone||"").trim(),email=String(body&&body.email||"").trim(),subject=String(body&&body.subject||"Genel Bilgi").trim(),message=String(body&&body.message||"").trim();

      const phoneDigits=phone.replace(/\D/g,"");

Yeni teklif olu\u015fturun.'},409);duplicate=Number(result.meta?.changes||0)===0;}
      }catch(e){console.error("OKYANUS_CONTACT_ADMIN_D1_ERROR",e);return responseJSON({ok:false,error:"CONTACT_SAVE_FAILED",message:"Mesaj kaydedilemedi. L\u00fctfen tekrar deneyin."},503)}

    function b2bPublicCatalog(){
      const src=(typeof ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CATALOG!=="undefined"?ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CATALOG:[]).filter(p=>
        String(p.category||"").replace(/İ/g,'i').replace(/I/g,'ı').toLowerCase().includes("deniz") ||
        String(p.masterCategory||"").replace(/İ/g,'i').replace(/I/g,'ı').toLowerCase().includes("deniz") ||
        String(p.subCategory||"").replace(/İ/g,'i').replace(/I/g,'ı').toLowerCase().includes("deniz")
      );
      /** @type {Map<string, any>} D1 ve sabit katalog alanlar\u0131 birlikte tutulur. */
      const all=new Map(SEA_FEATURED_PRODUCTS.map(p=>[String(p.id),{...p}]));
      for(const p of src){const id=String(p.id);if(!all.has(id))all.set(id,{id,name:String(p.name||""),category:String(p.category||"Deniz \u00dcr\u00fcnleri"),unit:String(p.amount||"Kg"),package:String(p.package||""),detail:String(p.detail||"")})}
      return [...all.values()];
    }
    // D1 overrides the same product IDs; new D1 products extend the existing catalog.
    // An explicit inactive D1 row withdraws its matching legacy item.
    async function b2bMergedCatalog(env){
      if(env.__okyCatalogFallback||env.__okyCatalogBootstrap)return {products:OKY_EDT_SEAFOOD_SNAPSHOT.products.map(p=>({...p,id:String(p.source_product_id||p.id),price:p.effectivePrice,package:p.package_text||'',stockStatus:p.stock_status})),source:'SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_PENDING_MIGRATION'};
      const base=b2bPublicCatalog();
      const rows=(await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM b2b_products_v1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC`).all()).results||[];
      /** @type {Map<string, any>} \u00dcr\u00fcn alanlar\u0131 D1 kay\u0131tlar\u0131yla geni\u015fletilir. */
      const byId=new Map(base.map(p=>[String(p.id),p]));
      for(const row of rows){
        const id=String(row.source_product_id||row.id);
        if(!SEA_FEATURED_PRODUCTS.some(p=>p.id===id)){continue}
        if(!row.active||retiredSupplierProduct(row)){byId.delete(id);continue}
        byId.set(id,{...(byId.get(id)||{}),id,storageId:String(row.id),name:String(row.name||''),category:String(row.category||'Deniz \u00dcr\u00fcnleri'),unit:String(row.unit||'Kg'),package:String(row.package_text||''),image:String(row.image_url||''),detail:[row.origin,row.freshness,row.processing].filter(Boolean).join(' \u00b7 '),stockStatus:row.stock_status,minOrder:row.min_order});
      }
      return {products:[...byId.values()].filter(p=>!retiredSupplierProduct(p)),source:rows.length?'D1_MERGED':'STATIC_BOOTSTRAP'};
    }
    async function b2bMemberContext(request,env){
      if(!memberPortalEnabled(env)) return null;
      return await memberSession(request,env);
    }
    async function b2bApi(request,env,url){
      await b2bEnsureSchema(env);
      const path=url.pathname;
      if(request.method==="GET"&&path==="/api/b2b/showcase"){
        const rows=(await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT id,category,title,subtitle,image_url,cta_text,cta_url,sort_order FROM b2b_showcase_v1 WHERE slot='seafood_b2b' AND active=1 ORDER BY sort_order,id LIMIT 12`).all()).results||[];
        return b2bJson({ok:true,data:rows});
      }
      const detailMatch=path.match(/^\/api\/b2b\/products\/([^/]+)$/);
      if(request.method==="GET"&&detailMatch)return await b2bPublicProductDetail(env,decodeURIComponent(detailMatch[1]),request);
      const repeatMatch=path.match(/^\/api\/b2b\/quotes\/([^/]+)\/repeat$/);
      if(request.method==="POST"&&repeatMatch)return await b2bPublicRepeatQuote(request,env,decodeURIComponent(repeatMatch[1]));
      if(request.method==="GET"&&path==="/api/b2b/products"){
        const {products,source}=await b2bMergedCatalog(env);
        const me=await b2bMemberContext(request,env);
        let priceMap=new Map();
        if(me&&me.business_id){
          const businessId=String(me.business_id);
          const rows=(await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT p.product_id,COALESCE(cp.price,p.price) price,COALESCE(cp.currency,p.currency,'TRY') currency
            FROM b2b_prices_v1 p LEFT JOIN b2b_customer_prices_v1 cp
            ON cp.product_id=p.product_id AND cp.business_id=? AND cp.active=1
            AND (cp.valid_until IS NULL OR cp.valid_until>datetime('now'))
            WHERE p.active=1 AND (p.valid_until IS NULL OR p.valid_until>datetime('now'))
            ORDER BY p.valid_from DESC`).bind(businessId).all()).results||[];
          for(const r of rows)if(!priceMap.has(String(r.product_id)))priceMap.set(String(r.product_id),{price:Number(r.price),currency:r.currency});
        }
        const data=products.map(p=>{const q=priceMap.get(String(p.storageId||p.id))||priceMap.get(String(p.id));return q?{...p,effectivePrice:q.price,currency:q.currency}:p});
        return b2bJson({ok:true,count:data.length,source,priceVisibility:me?"MEMBER":"LOGIN_REQUIRED",products:data});
      }
      if(request.method==="GET"&&path==="/api/b2b/prices"){
        const me=await b2bMemberContext(request,env);
        if(!me) return b2bJson({ok:false,error:"UNAUTHENTICATED"},401);
        const businessId=String(me.business_id||"");
        if(!businessId) return b2bJson({ok:false,error:"BUSINESS_CONTEXT_REQUIRED"},403);
        const rows=(await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT p.product_id,
          COALESCE(cp.price,p.price) price,COALESCE(cp.currency,p.currency,'TRY') currency
          FROM b2b_prices_v1 p LEFT JOIN b2b_customer_prices_v1 cp
          ON cp.product_id=p.product_id AND cp.business_id=? AND cp.active=1
          AND (cp.valid_until IS NULL OR cp.valid_until>datetime('now'))

    async function b2bPublicProductDetail(env,productId,request){
      await b2bEnsureSchema(env);
      const product=(await b2bMergedCatalog(env)).products.find(x=>String(x.id)===productId);
      if(!product)return b2bJson({ok:false,error:"PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND"},404);
      const me=await b2bMemberContext(request,env);
      let price=null;
      if(me&&me.business_id){
        const r=await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT COALESCE(cp.price,p.price) price,COALESCE(cp.currency,p.currency,'TRY') currency
          FROM b2b_prices_v1 p LEFT JOIN b2b_customer_prices_v1 cp ON cp.product_id=p.product_id AND cp.business_id=? AND cp.active=1
          WHERE p.product_id IN (?,?) AND p.active=1 AND (p.valid_until IS NULL OR p.valid_until>datetime('now'))
          ORDER BY CASE WHEN cp.price IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,p.valid_from DESC,p.rowid DESC LIMIT 1`).bind(String(me.business_id),productId,String(product.storageId||productId)).first();
        if(r)price={value:Number(r.price),currency:r.currency};
      }
      return b2bJson({ok:true,product,price,priceVisibility:me?"MEMBER":"LOGIN_REQUIRED"});
    }
    async function b2bPublicRepeatQuote(request,env,quoteId){
      const me=await b2bMemberContext(request,env);if(!me)return b2bJson({ok:false,error:"UNAUTHENTICATED"},401);
      if(!memberSameOrigin(request))return b2bJson({ok:false,error:"ORIGIN_REJECTED"},403);
      const businessId=String(me.business_id||"");if(!businessId)return b2bJson({ok:false,error:"BUSINESS_CONTEXT_REQUIRED"},403);
      const old=await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM b2b_quotes_v1 WHERE id=? AND business_id=? AND customer_id=? LIMIT 1`).bind(quoteId,businessId,me.user_id).first();
      if(!old)return b2bJson({ok:false,error:"QUOTE_NOT_FOUND"},404);
      const items=(await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT product_id,product_name,unit,quantity FROM b2b_quote_items_v1 WHERE quote_id=?`).bind(quoteId).all()).results||[];
      if(!items.length)return b2bJson({ok:false,error:"EMPTY_QUOTE"},400);
      const current=new Map((await b2bMergedCatalog(env)).products.map(p=>[String(p.id),p]));
      for(const x of items){const p=current.get(String(x.product_id));if(!p||Number(p.active)===0||/^OUT$/i.test(String(p.stock_status||p.stockStatus||"")))return b2bJson({ok:false,error:"PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE",productId:x.product_id},400);const quantity=b2bNum(x.quantity,0.001,100000);if(quantity===null)return b2bJson({ok:false,error:"INVALID_ITEM",productId:x.product_id},400);x.product_name=p.name;x.unit=p.unit||"Kg";x.quantity=quantity;}
      const id=crypto.randomUUID(),quoteNo=b2bQuoteNo();
      const statements=[
        env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO b2b_quotes_v1(id,quote_no,business_id,customer_id,company_name,contact_name,phone,email,delivery_region,note,status)
          VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'NEW')`).bind(id,quoteNo,businessId,old.customer_id,old.company_name,old.contact_name,old.phone,old.email,old.delivery_region,"Tekrar sipari\u015f / \u00f6nceki teklif: "+old.quote_no),
        ...items.map(x=>env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO b2b_quote_items_v1(id,quote_id,product_id,product_name,unit,quantity) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)`).bind(crypto.randomUUID(),id,x.product_id,x.product_name,x.unit,x.quantity))
      ];
      await env.DB.batch(statements);
      return b2bJson({ok:true,id,quoteNo,status:"NEW"},201);
    }

let openingAssetMemo=null;
async function openingCampaignAsset(request,env){
 const DB=commerceDatabase(env);if(!DB)return new Response('Not found',{status:404});
 try{
  const row=await DB.prepare("SELECT value,updated_at FROM oky_storefront_settings_v1 WHERE key='openingCampaignImage'").first();
  const value=String(row?.value||''),match=/^data:image\/(png|jpeg|webp);base64,/i.exec(value);if(!match)return new Response('Not found',{status:404});
  const mime=match[1].toLowerCase();
  if(!openingAssetMemo||openingAssetMemo.value!==value){
   const binary=atob(value.slice(match[0].length)),bytes=new Uint8Array(binary.length);for(let i=0;i<binary.length;i++)bytes[i]=binary.charCodeAt(i);
   const digest=new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',bytes)),hash=Array.from(digest,v=>v.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
   openingAssetMemo={value,bytes,etag:'"opening-'+mime+'-'+hash+'"'};
  }
  const headers={'content-type':'image/'+mime,'cache-control':'public, max-age=0, must-revalidate','etag':openingAssetMemo.etag,'x-content-type-options':'nosniff'};
  if(request.headers.get('if-none-match')===openingAssetMemo.etag)return new Response(null,{status:304,headers});
  if(request.method==='HEAD')return new Response(null,{headers});
  return new Response(openingAssetMemo.bytes,{headers});
 }catch{return new Response('Image unavailable',{status:503,headers:{'cache-control':'no-store'}})}
}

async function newsletterApi(request,env){
 const DB=commerceDatabase(env);if(!DB)return json({ok:false,error:"DB_NOT_BOUND"},503);
 if(request.method!=="POST")return json({ok:false,error:"METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED"},405);
 let b={};try{b=await request.json()}catch{return json({ok:false,error:"INVALID_JSON"},400)}
 const email=String(b.email||"").trim().toLowerCase(),name=String(b.name||"").trim().slice(0,120);if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email))return json({ok:false,error:"INVALID_EMAIL"},400);if(b.consent!==true)return json({ok:false,error:"CONSENT_REQUIRED"},400);
 try{const has=await DB.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='oky_newsletter_subscribers_v1'").first();if(!has)return json({ok:false,error:"NEWSLETTER_NOT_READY"},503);await DB.prepare("INSERT INTO oky_newsletter_subscribers_v1(id,email,name,consent_version,status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?, 'ACTIVE',datetime('now'),datetime('now')) ON CONFLICT(email) DO UPDATE SET name=excluded.name,consent_version=excluded.consent_version,status='ACTIVE',updated_at=datetime('now')").bind(crypto.randomUUID(),email,name||null,"2026-09-30-newsletter").run();return json({ok:true,status:"ACTIVE"},201)}catch{return json({ok:false,error:"NEWSLETTER_SAVE_FAILED"},500)}
}

function publicCampaignRuleAllowed(rule){return [rule.customer_segment,rule.delivery_zone].every(value=>{const scope=String(value??'').trim().toUpperCase();return scope===''||scope==='ALL'})}

const OKY_STOREFRONT_SCHEMA = new WeakMap();
/** Schema only: product edits and publication are read live on every request. */
const OKY_STOREFRONT_INDEX_TASKS = new WeakMap();
async function okyEnsureStorefrontIndexes(DB,schema){
 if(OKY_STOREFRONT_INDEX_TASKS.has(DB))return OKY_STOREFRONT_INDEX_TASKS.get(DB);
 const pending=(async()=>{const specs=[
 {table:'b2b_products_v1',name:'oky_perf_products_source',cols:['source_product_id']},
 {table:'b2b_products_v1',name:'oky_perf_products_active_category',cols:['active','category','updated_at','id']},
 {table:'b2b_prices_v1',name:'oky_perf_prices_current',cols:['product_id','active','valid_from']},
 {table:'oky_product_meta_v1',name:'oky_perf_meta_featured',cols:['featured','product_id']},
 {table:'oky_product_commerce_v1',name:'oky_perf_commerce_best',cols:['best_seller','product_id']}
 ];const queries=[];for(const {table,name,cols}of specs){const available=schema.columns.get(table);if(available&&cols.every(c=>available.has(c)))queries.push(DB.prepare('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS '+name+' ON '+table+'('+cols.map(c=>c==='valid_from'||c==='updated_at'?c+' DESC':c).join(',')+')'))}if(queries.length){if(typeof DB.batch==='function')await DB.batch(queries);else for(const q of queries)await q.run()}})();
 OKY_STOREFRONT_INDEX_TASKS.set(DB,pending);try{await pending}catch(error){OKY_STOREFRONT_INDEX_TASKS.delete(DB);throw error}
}
async function okyStorefrontSchema(DB){
 const old=OKY_STOREFRONT_SCHEMA.get(DB);if(old&&Date.now()-old.at<60000)return old.pending;
 const pending=(async()=>{const inventory=['b2b_products_v1','oky_product_meta_v1','oky_product_commerce_v1','oky_brands_v1','b2b_prices_v1','oky_storefront_banners_v1','oky_storefront_categories_v1','oky_storefront_sections_v1','oky_campaigns_v1','oky_campaign_rules_v1','oky_delivery_rules_v1','oky_help_articles_v1','oky_storefront_settings_v1','oky_seo_links_v1'];const tables=new Set(((await DB.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ("+inventory.map(()=>'?').join(',')+")").bind(...inventory).all()).results||[]).map(x=>x.name));const names=inventory.slice(0,5);const results=await Promise.all(names.map(async name=>[name,tables.has(name)?new Set(((await DB.prepare('PRAGMA table_info('+name+')').all()).results||[]).map(x=>x.name)):new Set()]));const columnMap=new Map();for(const row of results)columnMap.set(row[0],row[1]);const schema={tables,columns:columnMap};await okyEnsureStorefrontIndexes(DB,schema);return schema})();
 OKY_STOREFRONT_SCHEMA.set(DB,{at:Date.now(),pending});try{return await pending}catch(error){OKY_STOREFRONT_SCHEMA.delete(DB);throw error}
}
function okyCategorySlug(v){return String(v||'').replace(/İ/g,'i').replace(/I/g,'ı').toLowerCase().normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/ı/g,'i').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g,'')}
const OKY_CATEGORY_FILTERS=new Map();
function okyCategoryFilter(category){const key=okyCategorySlug(category);if(OKY_CATEGORY_FILTERS.has(key))return OKY_CATEGORY_FILTERS.get(key);const main=OKY_EDT_SOURCE_CATALOG.filter(p=>okyCategorySlug(p.category)===key);const leaf=OKY_EDT_SOURCE_CATALOG.filter(p=>okyCategorySlug(p.subcategory)===key);const seafood=['deniz-urunleri','su-urunleri'].includes(key);const matching=main.length?main:leaf;const result={ids:JSON.stringify(matching.map(p=>p.id)),categories:JSON.stringify(seafood?['Deniz Ürünleri','Su Ürünleri']:main.length?[...new Set(main.map(p=>p.category))]:[])};OKY_CATEGORY_FILTERS.set(key,result);return result}

async function storefront(env,productTarget="",homepageOnly=false,asData=false,pageOffset=0,categoryFilter="",searchFilter="",productsOnly=false){

AND b.active=1':'')+' LIMIT 1)':pCols.has('brand')?'p.brand':null;if(brandExpr)metaFields.push(brandExpr+' AS brand');const metaCols=metaFields.length?','+metaFields.join(','):'';
    const commerceFields=['sku','barcode','subcategory','origin','storage_conditions','cold_chain','min_order_qty','qty_step','list_price','sale_price','new_until','best_seller'].filter(n=>cCols.has(n)).map(n=>'pc.'+n+' AS '+n);const commerceCols=commerceFields.length?','+commerceFields.join(','):'';

    const order=(mCols.has('featured')?"COALESCE(m.featured,0) DESC,":"")+(cCols.has('best_seller')?"COALESCE(pc.best_seller,0) DESC,":"")+(mCols.has('sort_order')?"COALESCE(m.sort_order,0),":"")+(pCols.has('updated_at')?'p.updated_at DESC,p.id':'p.id');
    const priceExpr=priceCols.has('product_id')&&priceCols.has('price')?"(SELECT price FROM b2b_prices_v1 pr WHERE pr.product_id=p.id"+(priceCols.has('active')?' AND pr.active=1':'')+(priceCols.has('valid_until')?" AND (pr.valid_until IS NULL OR datetime(pr.valid_until)>datetime('now'))":"")+(priceCols.has('valid_from')?" AND (pr.valid_from IS NULL OR datetime(pr.valid_from)<=datetime('now')) ORDER BY pr.valid_from DESC,pr.rowid DESC":' ORDER BY pr.rowid DESC')+' LIMIT 1)':'NULL';
    let detailId="";
    if(productTarget){
     const detailSlug=v=>String(v||"").replace(/İ/g,'i').replace(/I/g,'ı').toLowerCase().normalize("NFKD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,"").replace(/\u0131/g,"i").replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g,"");

    products=rows.filter(x=>!retiredSupplierProduct(x)).map(x=>{const sale=Number(x.sale_price),base=Number(x.basePrice),list=Number(x.list_price);const saleOk=x.sale_price!=null&&x.sale_price!==""&&Number.isFinite(sale)&&sale>=0;const baseOk=x.basePrice!=null&&x.basePrice!==""&&Number.isFinite(base)&&base>=0;const listOk=x.list_price!=null&&x.list_price!==""&&Number.isFinite(list)&&list>=0;const effectivePrice=saleOk?sale:(baseOk?base:(listOk?list:null));const listPrice=listOk?list:(saleOk&&baseOk&&base>sale?base:null);const discountPercent=listPrice!=null&&effectivePrice!=null&&listPrice>effectivePrice?Math.round((1-effectivePrice/listPrice)*100):0;x.effectivePrice=effectivePrice;x.listPrice=listPrice;x.discountPercent=discountPercent;return x});

/* WEEKLY_NEWSLETTER_START */
function newsletterWeek(now=new Date()){
 const fmt=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Europe/Istanbul',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',second:'2-digit',hourCycle:'h23'});
 const parts=d=>Object.fromEntries(fmt.formatToParts(d).filter(p=>p.type!=='literal').map(p=>[p.type,Number(p.value)]));
 const p=parts(now),day=Date.UTC(p.year,p.month-1,p.day),monday=day-((new Date(day).getUTCDay()+6)%7)*86400000;
 const midnight=local=>{let instant=local;for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const q=parts(new Date(instant));instant+=local-Date.UTC(q.year,q.month-1,q.day,q.hour,q.minute,q.second)}return new Date(instant).toISOString()};
 return {weekKey:new Date(monday).toISOString().slice(0,10),periodEnd:new Date(monday+6*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10),startsAt:midnight(monday),nextRefreshAt:midnight(monday+7*86400000),timeZone:'Europe/Istanbul'};
}
function newsletterSafeUrl(value,fallback='/urunler'){const s=String(value||'').trim();return /^\/(?!\/)|^https:\/\//i.test(s)?s:fallback}
function newsletterPrice(value){return value!==null&&value!==undefined&&String(value).trim()!==''&&Number.isFinite(Number(value))&&Number(value)>=0?Number(value):null}
function newsletterEdition(catalog,now=new Date()){
 const week=newsletterWeek(now),hash=s=>{let h=2166136261;for(const c of s){h^=c.charCodeAt(0);h=Math.imul(h,16777619)}return h>>>0},seen=new Set();
 const source=Array.isArray(catalog.products)?catalog.products:[];
 const pictured=source.filter(p=>{const image=String(p.image??p.image_url??'');return /^data:image\/(?:png|jpeg|webp|gif);base64,/i.test(image)||!!newsletterSafeUrl(image,'')});
 const pool=pictured.length>=12?pictured:source;
 const ranked=pool.filter(p=>{const id=String(p.source_product_id||p.id||'');if(!id||!p.name||seen.has(id))return false;seen.add(id);return true}).map(p=>({p,score:hash(week.weekKey+'|'+String(p.source_product_id||p.id))})).sort((a,b)=>a.score-b.score||String(a.p.id).localeCompare(String(b.p.id)));
 const picked=[],categories=new Set();for(const r of ranked){const category=String(r.p.category||'');if(!categories.has(category)){picked.push(r.p);categories.add(category)}if(picked.length===12)break}for(const r of ranked){if(picked.length===12)break;if(!picked.includes(r.p))picked.push(r.p)}
 const products=picked.map(p=>{const id=String(p.source_product_id||p.id),price=newsletterPrice(p.effectivePrice??p.price??p.sale_price??p.list_price),listPrice=newsletterPrice(p.listPrice??p.list_price),rawImage=String(p.image??p.image_url??'');return {id,name:String(p.name),brand:String(p.brand||''),category:String(p.category||''),package:String(p.package_text||p.package||p.amount||''),unit:String(p.unit||'Adet'),price,listPrice:listPrice!==null&&price!==null&&listPrice>price?listPrice:null,currency:'TRY',image:/^data:image\/(?:png|jpeg|webp|gif);base64,/i.test(rawImage)?rawImage:newsletterSafeUrl(rawImage,''),url:'/urun/'+encodeURIComponent(id),campaignLabel:String(p.campaignLabel||'')}});
 return {ok:true,...week,title:'Okyanus EDT Haftal\u0131k E-b\u00fclten',generatedAt:now.toISOString(),products,campaigns:(Array.isArray(catalog.campaigns)?catalog.campaigns:[]).slice(0,6).map(c=>({id:c.id,title:String(c.title||'Kampanya'),description:String(c.description||''),url:newsletterSafeUrl(c.cta_url,'/kampanyalar'),ctaText:String(c.cta_text||'Kampanyay\u0131 incele')}))};
}
async function newsletterRead(env,now=new Date()){
 const catalog=await (await storefront(env)).json();
 if(!catalog.catalogAuthoritative&&typeof ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CATALOG!=='undefined'){const ids=new Set(catalog.products.map(p=>String(p.source_product_id||p.id)));for(const p of ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CATALOG){const id=String(p.source_product_id||p.id);if(!ids.has(id)){catalog.products.push({...p,image:commerceProductImage(p)});ids.add(id)}}}
 return newsletterEdition(catalog,now);
}

// Remove the retired supplier name at public boundaries, including legacy D1 rows.
function neutralCatalogValue(value) {
 if(typeof value === "string")return neutralCatalogText(value);
 if(Array.isArray(value))return value.map(neutralCatalogValue);
 if(value&&typeof value === "object")return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key,item])=>[key,neutralCatalogValue(item)]));
 return value;
}
function neutralCatalogText(value) {
 const text=String(value);if(!/kul[\s_-]*g[\u0131i]da|kulgida\.com/iu.test(text))return text;return text.replace(/https?:\/\/kulgida\.com(?:\/[^\s"<>]*)?/giu, "").replace(/kul[\s_-]*g[\u0131i]da/giu, "");
}

// Compatibility URLs redirect to the exact original image bytes stored separately.
function okyEmbeddedAsset(request){
 const path=new URL(request.url).pathname,url=OKY_STATIC_ASSET_URLS[path];
 if(!url){if(path.startsWith('/assets/oky-embedded-r36/'))return new Response('Not found',{status:404});return null;}
 if(!['GET','HEAD'].includes(request.method))return new Response(null,{status:405,headers:{allow:'GET, HEAD'}});
 return new Response(null,{status:302,headers:{location:url,'cache-control':'public, max-age=300','x-content-type-options':'nosniff'}});
}

const okyR40InnerWorker = {
 async fetch(request, env, ctx) {
  const inputType=request.headers.get("content-type")||"";
  const incomingPath=new URL(request.url).pathname;const sensitive=/login|logout|password|session|auth|register|csrf/i.test(incomingPath);
  const embedded=okyEmbeddedAsset(request);if(embedded)return embedded;
  if(!sensitive&&!["GET","HEAD"].includes(request.method)&&/application\/json|application\/x-www-form-urlencoded/i.test(inputType)){
   const original=await request.clone().text();let clean=neutralCatalogText(original);
   if(/application\/x-www-form-urlencoded/i.test(inputType)){const form=new URLSearchParams(original);for(const [key,value]of form)form.set(key,neutralCatalogText(value));clean=form.toString();}
   if((clean!==original||original.includes("\\"))&&/application\/json/i.test(inputType)){try{clean=JSON.stringify(neutralCatalogValue(JSON.parse(original)))}catch{}}
   if(clean!==original){const headers=new Headers(request.headers);headers.delete("content-length");request=new Request(request,{headers,body:clean});}
  }
  const response=await denizWorker.fetch(request,env,ctx),type=response.headers.get("content-type")||"";
  if(request.method==="HEAD")return new Response(null,{status:response.status,statusText:response.statusText,headers:response.headers});
  if(sensitive)return response;
  if(!response.body||!/application\/json|text\/html|text\/plain/i.test(type))return response;
  if(response.headers.has("x-okyanus-commerce"))return response;
  const original=await response.text();let clean=neutralCatalogText(original);
  if(clean!==original&&/application\/json/i.test(type)){try{clean=JSON.stringify(neutralCatalogValue(JSON.parse(original)))}catch{}}
  const headers=new Headers(response.headers);headers.delete("content-length");
  return new Response(clean,{status:response.status,statusText:response.statusText,headers});
 },
 scheduled(event,env,ctx){return denizWorker.scheduled(event,env,ctx)}
};
