// R40 response hardening; report-only script policy preserves existing inline modules.
async function okyR40SecureResponse(request,response,admin=false){
 if(response.status===101)return response;
 const headers=new Headers(response.headers),path=new URL(request.url).pathname;
 if(admin||path==='/api'||path.startsWith('/api/'))headers.set('x-robots-tag','noindex, nofollow');
 headers.set('strict-transport-security','max-age=31536000');
 headers.set('x-content-type-options','nosniff');
 headers.set('x-frame-options','DENY');
 // R44 preserve route policies rather than replacing stricter administrator restrictions.
 if(!headers.has('referrer-policy'))headers.set('referrer-policy','strict-origin-when-cross-origin');
 if(!headers.has('permissions-policy'))headers.set('permissions-policy','camera=(self), microphone=(), geolocation=()');
 const existingCsp=headers.get('content-security-policy')||'';
 const requiredCsp=[["base-uri","'self'"],["object-src","'none'"],["frame-ancestors","'none'"]];
 const additions=requiredCsp.filter(([name])=>!new RegExp('(?:^|;)\\s*'+name+'(?:\\s|$)','i').test(existingCsp)).map(([name,value])=>name+' '+value);
 headers.set('content-security-policy',[existingCsp,...additions].filter(Boolean).join('; '));
 headers.set('content-security-policy-report-only',"default-src 'self' https:; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' https: data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https:; font-src 'self' https: data:; worker-src 'self' blob:");
 // R44 cache only successfully served public raster UUID assets.
 const publicRaster=request.method==='GET'||request.method==='HEAD';
 const publicMedia=publicRaster&&response.status===200&&!headers.has('set-cookie')&&/^\/studio-media\/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\.(?:png|jpg|webp)$/i.test(path)&&/^image\/(?:png|jpeg|webp)(?:;|$)/i.test(headers.get('content-type')||'');
 if(publicMedia)headers.set('cache-control','public, max-age=3600');
 if(!publicMedia&&(admin||request.headers.has('authorization')||request.headers.has('cookie')||headers.has('set-cookie')||/^\/(?:api\/(?:member|auth|admin)|uye|hesabim|yonetici)(?:\/|$)/.test(path))){
  headers.set('cache-control','private, no-store');
  headers.delete('expires');headers.delete('etag');
  const vary=headers.get('vary');if(vary!=='*')headers.set('vary',[vary,'Cookie','Authorization'].filter(Boolean).join(', '));
 }
 if(request.method!=='HEAD'&&/text\/html/i.test(headers.get('content-type')||'')){
  const content=okyR54PublicHTML(await response.text());headers.delete('content-length');return new Response(content,{status:response.status,statusText:response.statusText,headers});
 }
 return new Response(request.method==='HEAD'?null:response.body,{status:response.status,statusText:response.statusText,headers});
}

export default {
 async fetch(request,env,ctx){
  const legacyLoginUrl=new URL(request.url);
  if(['/uye-giris','/giris'].includes(legacyLoginUrl.pathname)&&['GET','HEAD'].includes(request.method)){legacyLoginUrl.pathname='/uye';return okyR40SecureResponse(request,new Response(null,{status:302,headers:{location:legacyLoginUrl.pathname+legacyLoginUrl.search,'cache-control':'no-store','x-robots-tag':'noindex, nofollow'}}));}
  if(new URL(request.url).pathname.startsWith('/studio-media/'))return okyR40SecureResponse(request,await okyR44ReadStudioAsset(request,env));

  if(new URL(request.url).pathname==='/api/catalog-status'){
   if(!['GET','HEAD'].includes(request.method))return new Response(null,{status:405,headers:{allow:'GET, HEAD'}});
   const DB=env&&(env.COMMERCE_DB||env.ADMIN_DB||env.DB||env['Veritabanı']||env['Veritabani']||env['Veritabanı1']);let complete=false,errorCode=null,priceComplete=false,affectedProducts=null;
   try{if(DB)complete=!!await DB.prepare('SELECT id FROM oky_catalog_import_batches_v1 WHERE id=?').bind(OKY_EDT_MIGRATION).first();else errorCode='DATABASE_NOT_BOUND'}catch{errorCode='STATUS_READ_FAILED'}
   try{if(DB){const priceState=await DB.prepare('SELECT product_count FROM oky_price15_migrations_v1 WHERE id=?').bind(OKY_PRICE15_MIGRATION).first();priceComplete=!!priceState;affectedProducts=priceState?.product_count??null}}catch{}
   const failure=DB?OKY_EDT_LAST_FAILURE.get(DB):null;
   return new Response(request.method==='HEAD'?null:JSON.stringify({ok:true,migrationComplete:complete,priceIncreaseApplied:priceComplete,priceIncreasePercent:15,priceAffectedProducts:affectedProducts,catalogSource:complete?'D1':'VERIFIED_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT',expectedImported:789,preservedSeafood:44,lastFailure:failure?{code:failure.code,stage:failure.stage}:errorCode?{code:errorCode}:null}),{headers:{'content-type':'application/json; charset=utf-8','cache-control':'no-store','x-robots-tag':'noindex'}});
  }

  if(new URL(request.url).pathname==='/api/health'){
   const allowed=request.method==='GET'||request.method==='HEAD';
   const response=new Response(allowed?JSON.stringify({ok:true,service:'okyanus-edt-web',checkedAt:new Date().toISOString(),scope:'web-worker'}):JSON.stringify({ok:false,error:'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED'}),{status:allowed?200:405,headers:{'content-type':'application/json; charset=utf-8','cache-control':'no-store','allow':'GET, HEAD','x-robots-tag':'noindex'}});
   return okyR40SecureResponse(request,response);
  }

  return okyR40SecureResponse(request,await okyR40InnerWorker.fetch(request,env,ctx),false);
 },
 scheduled(event,env,ctx){return okyR40InnerWorker.scheduled?.(event,env,ctx)}
};

function okyR44ProductUnavailable(product){
 if(!product)return true;
 if(product.active===false||product.active===0||product.active==='0')return true;
 const stock=String(product.stock_status||product.stockStatus||'').trim();
 return /^(?:OUT|INACTIVE|DISABLED|UNAVAILABLE|SOLD_OUT|OUT_OF_STOCK)$/i.test(stock)||/stok yok|t\u00fckendi|pasif|inactive|out of stock/i.test(stock);
}

// R44 public studio media reader: fixed asset IDs only; KV and R2 supported.
async function okyR44ReadStudioAsset(request,env,headers=new Headers()){
 const path=new URL(request.url).pathname,id=path.slice('/studio-media/'.length);
 const reply=(status,error)=>new Response(JSON.stringify({ok:false,error}),{status,headers:{'content-type':'application/json','cache-control':'no-store'}});
 if(!['GET','HEAD'].includes(request.method))return reply(405,'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED');
 if(!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\.(?:png|jpg|webp)$/i.test(id))return reply(404,'MEDIA_NOT_FOUND');
 const store=env&&env.MEDIA_STORE;if(!store)return reply(503,'MEDIA_STORE_NOT_BOUND');
 try{
  let body,meta={};
  if(typeof store.getWithMetadata==='function'){const got=await store.getWithMetadata('studio/'+id,{type:'arrayBuffer'});body=got?.value;meta=got?.metadata||{}}
  else {const got=await store.get('studio/'+id);body=got?.body;meta={...(got?.customMetadata||{}),mime:got?.httpMetadata?.contentType||got?.customMetadata?.mime,size:got?.size}}
  if(!body)return reply(404,'MEDIA_NOT_FOUND');
  const mime=String(meta.mime||'');if(!['image/png','image/jpeg','image/webp'].includes(mime))return reply(415,'IMAGE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED');
  const h=new Headers(headers);h.set('content-type',mime);h.set('cache-control','public, max-age=3600');h.set('x-content-type-options','nosniff');if(meta.size)h.set('content-length',String(meta.size));
  return new Response(request.method==='HEAD'?null:body,{status:200,headers:h});
 }catch{return reply(503,'MEDIA_READ_FAILED')}
}

// R54 public retirement policy: preserved engines are inaccessible, private data is untouched.
function okyR54RetiredPath(path){
 return /^\/(?:cost|cost-hesaplama|cost-radar|akademi|academy|cesni)(?:\/|$)/i.test(path)||/^\/api\/(?:cost|cost-radar|akademi|academy|cesni)(?:\/|$)/i.test(path);
}

function okyR54PublicHTML(content){
 const retired=/\bCOST\b|Cost Radar|COST Radar|Akademi|AKADEMÄ°|Ã‡EÅNÄ°|Ã‡eÅŸni/;
 const neutral="ÃœrÃ¼nleri katalogdan seÃ§in veya satÄ±n alma listenizin fotoÄŸrafÄ±nÄ± gÃ¶nderin; teklif talebinizi tek listede iletin.";
 // Script/style blocks stay byte-identical; private engines and client storage keys are untouched.
 return String(content).split(/(<script\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script>|<style\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/style>)/gi).map(part=>{
  if(/^<style\b/i.test(part))return part;
  if(/^<script\b/i.test(part)){
   if(!/application\/ld\+json/i.test(part))return part;
   try{const body=part.match(/>([\s\S]*)<\/script>/i)[1],value=JSON.parse(body);const walk=x=>{if(Array.isArray(x))return x.map(walk);if(x&&typeof x==='object'){for(const k of Object.keys(x)){if(k==='description'&&typeof x[k]==='string'&&retired.test(x[k]))x[k]=neutral;else x[k]=walk(x[k])}}return x};return part.replace(body,JSON.stringify(walk(value)))}catch{return part}
  }
  part=part.replace(/<a\b[^>]*href=["']\/(?:cost|cost-hesaplama|cost-radar|akademi|academy|cesni)(?:[/?#][^"']*)?["'][^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/a>/gi,'');
  part=part.replace(/<article\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/article>/gi,node=>retired.test(node)?'':node);
  part=part.replace(/<(p|span|h2|h3|strong)\b([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/\1>/gi,(node,tag,attrs,body)=>retired.test(body)?'<'+tag+attrs+'>'+neutral+'</'+tag+'>':node);
  part=part.replace(/<meta\b[^>]*>/gi,node=>node.replace(/content=(["'])([\s\S]*?)\1/,(_,q,value)=>'content='+q+(retired.test(value)?neutral:value)+q));
  return part;
 }).join('');
}
